maps.title: Rupa Siksa · Day 01 · Managing Our Wealth

nodeData.note: CC Madhya 19.1–7 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Mahaprabhu empowers Rupa Gosvami as the Lord once empowered Brahma; chanting needs no prior ritual; how the Gosvamis found the lost places of Vraja; and Rupa Gosvami's example of dividing his wealth — 50% to devotees, 25% to family, 25% kept for need. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: The chapter: Mahaprabhu instructs Rupa Gosvami
children.note: Caitanya-caritamrta, Madhya-lila chapter 19 — Sri Caitanya Mahaprabhu's instructions to Srila Rupa Gosvami, read in Vrindavan with Hindi translation. This series takes the chapter a few verses a day.

The opening verse compares two moments: the Lord filling Brahma's heart with knowledge before the creation, and Mahaprabhu filling Rupa Gosvami's heart with spiritual potency so that he could revive Krishna's Vrindavan pastimes, which were almost lost to memory.

Maharaj retells the start of creation: Brahma on the lotus understood nothing. He climbed down the stem, touched water, grew afraid and returned. Maharaj asks the room — if the lights go off here, what do you see? Nothing. That was Brahma's position until he heard the sound and performed austerity.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:53 (auto-transcript): “Shri Chaitanya Bhagwat, Bhrundavantastikura said, in the beginning the Brahma was unable to understand anything. Zero. He tried to understand what he got was fear. The Brahma came down from the lotus flower who was sitting. He came down and was tracing it. If the light goes…”

Brahma received realisation before he studied scripture; the scripture then confirmed what he had been shown. His ignorance left him, he saw the spiritual world in full variety, and only then did he compose his prayers.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:04 (auto-transcript): “Brahman was given the knowledge before he studied the scripture. scripture and he gave it to him. So we say a real scripture. Then he studied the scripture because now he has been given the strength to him. When the knowledge was given to him, His ignorance disappeared. What…”

The principle behind doing anything wonderful: we need empowerment, and empowerment follows strong sadhana. With it we can do what is beyond our own mind. — “We need empowerment. And empowerment comes from strong sadhana”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:06 (auto-transcript): “We need empowerment. And empowerment comes from strong sadhana, when strong sadhana is performed, empowerment comes, with empowerment, we can to do something beyond our mind.”

As the Lord trained Brahma, Mahaprabhu trained Rupa and Sanatana for their duty. He did not simply give the order; the training came first, then the order to go and act.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:52 (auto-transcript): “In exactly the same way, the Lord, He is anxious to revive the Vrindavan pastures of Krishna. Ashera trained the Brahma. Chaitanya Mahaprabhu trained Rupasarajan Koshpani for their duty. He did not just ask them to do it. the willing train.”

After meeting Mahaprabhu at Ramakeli the two brothers went home and worked out how to leave their material duties. They engaged brahmanas, paying them well, to perform purascarana and chant Krishna's holy name so that the brothers could soon reach the Lord's shelter.

A ritual performed under an expert guru or brahmana for the fulfilment of a desire: rising early, chanting the Hare Krishna mantra, mangala-arati and deity worship. The details are in Madhya-lila chapter 15.
In his purport Srila Prabhupada points to Madhya 15.108: initiation and preliminary pious acts are not required; one simply vibrates the holy name, and even the lowest-born can be delivered.

Rupa and Sanatana did perform the ritual before taking fully to Krishna consciousness, and one might think we should do the same. Prabhupada places this verse here to say: it is not necessary. The qualification to chant is given by chanting itself.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:39 (auto-transcript): “I am quoting this verse from me some time back, this text file. That Rupa Goswami, Salatana Goswami, they did this ritual before taking it to Krishna consciousness. The idea was that, we should do the same thing. And here, Prabhupada has quoted this verse.”

No separate rite is needed to purify the soul before becoming a devotee; the Hare Krishna mantra is the best process and we need no other. — “The Hare Krishna mantra is initiation.”

🎙 Maharaj at 16:14 (auto-transcript): “So you don't have to do any rituals to purify our soul, become a Hare Krishna devotee. The Hare Krishna mantra is initiation. It is mentioned in chapter 6 of Bhagavatam. The heart doesn't want to try the best process of patternment, the best process.”

Rupa and Sanatana were first trained, then sent. Empowered, they could see the lost places of Krishna's pastimes from within rather than having to ask anyone.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:15 (auto-transcript): “First of all, Rupa Santana Goswami, so they know their village. Then he will be trained, but proper. Then the order was given, and you go on and seek what you do. So it is not to discover the personal places of Krishna's beloved.”

Today we find a restaurant or a maths class with GPS. The Gosvamis carried the 'chip' inside: they did not have to ask anybody, everything was shown to them, and then they wrote it down.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:21 (auto-transcript): “We generally have a restaurant. Math. Navigation. This is a house. GPS. GPS. So, group of other questions they have? GPS. Here they have the chip, they don't have to ask anybody. Show them everywhere. So, now exactly this part is your inner mind.”

The acts of pure devotees are perfect because there is no guesswork in them; the Supersoul shows the way. — “the activities of pure devotees are perfect because there is no speculation”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:45 (auto-transcript): “So the activities of pure devotees are perfect because there is no speculation. There is super-soul that our ship is super-soul. Surabhakti did not take Koran, he consulted the books, asked so many people, he couldn't”

A later example from the same principle: a great acarya consulted books and asked people for years without locating the Yoga-pitha, until it was revealed from within. To remove doubt, an aged devotee who could neither walk nor see, carried in a basket with eyes covered, jumped out at the spot and danced — this is the place of my Lord Gauracandra. So it was confirmed.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:17 (auto-transcript): “Surabhakti did not take Koran, he consulted the books, asked so many people, he couldn't get the exactity. He said, this is Yogpete. This is Yog-peed. He asked people for years, nobody could tell him. He read all the books available, no one could have found it.”

The Gosvamis took no photographs; everything was recorded inside. Maharaj contrasts this with us at a kirtan, phone raised, offending everyone behind us — and still thinking our technology makes us advanced.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:18 (auto-transcript): “Look at the sunset, they didn't do like that. The camera is... Where is the camera? Everything is loaded here. They could see from here. When you are doing your job taking, do you know how many people you offend? Do you know? How many people? Are all the people behind you…”

children.topic: Spreading Krishna consciousness to the world
children.note:
The verse says Rupa Gosvami spread Krishna consciousness throughout the world. Maharaj asks: did the Gosvamis travel to Europe? No — yet there is nowhere today you do not find their books and teaching.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:50 (auto-transcript): “So, in this way, Rupa Satham Goswami spread Krishnan consciously throughout the world. Kishitra Maku used them to spread Krishnan consciousness throughout the whole world. How did they do that? How did they do that? Kupab was saying, you went to Europe?”

children.topic: Krishna's hands and feet are everywhere
children.note: Citing the Gita's line that the Lord's hands and feet are everywhere, Maharaj explains that Krishna works through his expansions and through his devotees. He is unlimited, and he still has people carrying out his work in many ways.

The brothers arranged elaborate rites to free themselves for the path; the teaching is that chanting the holy name alone is enough.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:49 (auto-transcript): “So, Sanatana and Rupakishwam, they call to do chagira, for them to be freed, so they can go smoothly on the path of Christian consciousness. God, it is said, it is not necessary.”
Rupa Gosvami returned home with the wealth he had accumulated and divided it before leaving household life.

Half to brahmanas and Vaishnavas, a quarter to relatives, a quarter kept aside for personal emergencies. Prabhupada's purport presents this as the practical model for dividing one's money on retiring from family life.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:33 (auto-transcript): “Brahmane Vaishnavedi na dhara arda dhane, eka choti dhanna deva uthumbha gharane. Shri Harut Goswami nne ghar naye dhhan ko batwara kiya. She gave 50% of the art and skis to give us a gift. Then, by her husband, she gave us a gift to make her gift to help him with his…”

Maharaj asks the audience again and again whether this is practical today. Some say yes — then why is no one doing it? The honest answer in the room is that it is not being done.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:05 (auto-transcript): “Is it possible? Is it possible this time? Is it practical this time? Please, please listen. Is it practical this time? Yes. Is it practical this time? Yes, yes. You are doing it?”

If it is only for retirement, what is the guarantee of reaching retirement with the money intact? Many spend everything on illness before they die. The division should begin now; postponed, it is practical only for the very rich.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:57 (auto-transcript): “So, you are telling me that when you retire, you don't do this, it should be done now before retirement. Now, now. Therefore, it is not practical now. Now it is not practical. Even if you think that when I retire, what is the guarantee?”

Two questions from a visiting devotee, and a comment from the floor.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:43 (auto-transcript): “First of all, welcome to Vindavan. Thank you. Thank you for the lecture. I have two questions for you.”

children.topic: Q1 · Why empower souls who were already perfect?
children.note:
Rupa and Sanatana are eternal associates, not conditioned souls — so why did Mahaprabhu need to empower them? Maharaj calls it a very good question.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:29 (auto-transcript): “One is Rupa and Sanatana, they are perfected souls. What was the need for Chaitanya Mahaprabhu to empower them? Very good, very good question.”

When they descend, the Lord's associates behave like ordinary people, sometimes appearing worse off than us — at Ramakeli Mahaprabhu had to say to Sanatana, you have forgotten me. Their position is then revived and restored. This is the Lord's game.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:14 (auto-transcript): “They are not conditioned souls. and Chita Mahaprabhu Chita Mahaprabhu where he first met Pocanada Goswami Chita Mahaprabhu said you forgot me you forgot you don't recognize me oh yes ah yes That is their history, so the pure souls come here, they hide themselves, and sometimes”

Mahaprabhu said he came to Puri for three people — Ramananda Raya, Prataparudra and Sarvabhauma Bhattacarya — yet Sarvabhauma at first doubted his divinity on seeing him unconscious in ecstasy, and only later repented. Of the three only Ramananda was never bewildered.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:19 (auto-transcript): “Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, he told Sabha Bhavadacharya, I came to Jagannapuri, for three of him. Ramalanda Raya, Prataparudara Mahaprabhu, Sabha Bhavadacharya. But why Sabha Bhavadacharya didn't know that? Not even Prataparutra himself. Only out of the three, the other one who was…”

Another case: a scholar from outside our line was brought in by Visvanatha Cakravarti Thakura and sent alone to face the assembly of Vedantists challenging Radharani's place on the altar. The Lord positions his people and then reveals them.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:10 (auto-transcript): “Who is Babu Nsacharya? The husband of the system is Nsacharya. Who is? Who is? In Krishna-bena-Hashmi. He is Nsacharya. He is the same person. Banebude Bhushan. He was shown from my body. And was brought to her.”

children.topic: Guru is compulsory — even Krishna took one
children.note:
Second answer: Krishna himself accepted a spiritual master to teach us that guru is not optional. The Gosvamis did not need training, but they were put in the guru–disciple relationship for our benefit. — “All of us need training.”

🎙 Maharaj at 55:45 (auto-transcript): “Second way, Krishna himself took spiritual master. Why? Don't teach us. Guru is compulsive. In the same way, he trained them to show us the way. You know that they have forgotten, but they have to be put in a guru-disciple relationship for training, for our benefit. They are…”

Otherwise anyone could claim, I know my identity, I need no guru. Who makes you a gopi? One must pass through scripture; the system protects us from leaping to heights we have not reached.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:52 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, you have to pass through the scripture. If you are a Gopi, who makes you a Gopi? I'm going to go through scripture, so for training us, for protecting us from jumping to the height, we don't teach you. It's our protection. So Rumpasantan Koshisam, we are trained,…”

The translation of 15.108 says one vibrates the holy name with the lips, while the word-for-word gives tongue. Is there a difference? Maharaj has seen no explanation of a distinction.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:56 (auto-transcript): “My second question is regarding text number 5, it was regarding the verse that we read, 15 chapters, verse 1, 8. It says in the translation Prabhupada explains that one simply has to”

A comment from the floor: near the end, some disciples worried they could not hear Prabhupada chanting and consulted Krishnadasa Babaji, who opened Prabhupada's mouth and saw the tongue moving.

🎙 Maharaj at 60:12 (auto-transcript): “I have a small comment regarding this. In the last days, some disciples of Śrīla Prabhupāda were concerned about his chanting. So when Krishnadas Babaji came to see, they consult with him because they were not hearing Prabhupāda's chanting.”

Maharaj's response: we say Prabhupada, Prabhupada, but the heart does not. Who in this world has done what he did? Why doubt a pure devotee? Our doubts show where we stand.

🎙 Maharaj at 61:49 (auto-transcript): “I'm sorry to say, but it is faithlessness. We say Bravopad, Bravopad, Bravopad. But our heart doesn't say Bravopad. Why should we doubt in purely water?”

maps.title: Rupa Siksa · Day 02 · Affection OR Impediment

nodeData.note: CC Madhya 19.8–16 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Rupa Gosvami slips away from Gauda and keeps money aside for his brother's release, while Sanatana stays home pretending to be sick and reads Bhagavatam all day. Maharaj draws out the theme: the Nawab's fondness for Sanatana, like a mother's love or a host's hundred chapatis, is affection — and still an impediment to bhakti. Along the way he shows how Mahaprabhu plants devotees in Muslim, sudra, animal and demon families to prove that a devotee can come from anywhere. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Maharaj continues Madhya-lila 19 from text 8. These verses describe Rupa Gosvami's practical arrangements before leaving Gauda: money set aside, and scouts sent to Jagannatha Puri to learn when Mahaprabhu would set out for Vrindavan.

children.topic: 19.8 — Ten thousand coins with a grocer
children.note: The verse records a deposit Rupa Gosvami left with a local grocer, kept for personal safety because he foresaw legal trouble. Maharaj later explains that this is the money Sanatana Gosvami would need to free himself.

Hearing that Mahaprabhu had returned to Jagannatha Puri and meant to travel to Vrindavan through the forest, Rupa Gosvami sends two men to find out the date of departure so he can make his own arrangements.

Sanatana Gosvami, still in Gauda, wishes the Nawab would somehow become angry with him so he could be relieved of his post. He gives up his government work, does not attend court, and remains at home.

Maharaj reads the purport on Sanatana's secretarial staff: the Kayastha community that filled clerical posts, a mixture of castes, and the subordinate Purandara Khan who was eager to take over the minister's chair when Sanatana withdrew.

Maharaj explains that the two brothers were Sarasvata brahmanas, but because they accepted posts under the Muslim ruler the brahmana community rejected them and they even took Muslim names. Sanatana now feels the time has come for the real purpose of his life.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:01 (auto-transcript): “So what is happening is that… So what is happening is that… Sanatana Goswami was thinking it is time for him. The main purpose of his coming. Sriya Sanatana Goswami had been doing that he had to do what he had to do what he had to do He is himself and his brother they were a…”

children.topic: A devotee can come from anywhere
children.note:
Maharaj strings together Mahaprabhu's associates who appeared in unlikely families — Muslim, sudra, animal, demon — and says this was the Lord's plan to teach us that birth does not decide who is a devotee.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:27 (auto-transcript): “The same thing happened with Haridash Thakurji. Haridash Thakurji was born in a Brahmana family, but because he was a Muslim, when he is pregnant and dying alien. Haridash joined the Muslim. Many people, many people, I think the first time you are hearing this.”

Maharaj tells the room — many hearing it for the first time — that Haridasa Thakura was born in a brahmana family, lost his parents early and joined the Muslim community to survive; to this day he is counted a Muslim. Mahaprabhu told him his birth was superior, because he had purified that community.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:27 (auto-transcript): “The same thing happened with Haridash Thakurji. Haridash Thakurji was born in a Brahmana family, but because he was a Muslim, when he is pregnant and dying alien. Haridash joined the Muslim. Many people, many people, I think the first time you are hearing this.”

Hanuman was placed in an animal family though he is no animal; Prahlada in a demon's family. Maharaj repeats the lesson twice so it lands. — “A devotee can come from anywhere.”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:10 (auto-transcript): “The same way, Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu put Muradi Gupta, Hanuman Ji, animal family. He is not animal, but he put him there in animal family to teach us a lesson. He put Prahala Ji, demonic family, for culture.”

Narottama dasa Thakura and Ramananda Raya are gopis and manjaris in Krishna's lila, yet Mahaprabhu placed them in sudra families to preach. He said he is equal to all, and he demonstrated it in every species — animal, plant, human, demigod.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:18 (auto-transcript): “Narottam Dashthakul. Shri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu put in a new Sudra family. Sri Rama Nandaraya, Sudra family, Rama Nandaraya, Narottam Dashtakur, they are all manjaris, gopis, manjaris. But Shri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu put them in a low family to preach it. But Gita Mahaprabhu…”

children.topic: Nityananda sent where Ganga does not flow
children.note:
Even Nityananda Prabhu was sent to a land the Ganga does not touch, considered inauspicious. Maharaj quotes the acarya's explanation: wherever a devotee appears, the place becomes a holy place, so Mahaprabhu made the whole land auspicious by planting devotees everywhere.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:37 (auto-transcript): “Even Nityananda Prabhu Himself, he sent him to where Ganga does not flow, this inauspicious place. Where? What is the name before you go check? Rade, Ganga does not flow, that place is inauspicious. So, Vandamandas Chakra said, Krishna did this to make all ill-auspicious…”

When Narottama began initiating brahmanas, offended brahmanas prayed to Durga for power to defeat him. She appeared in one's dream and told him to take shelter of Narottama; another she struck with an incurable illness, telling him that what is a sudra to him is for her an expansion of the Supreme Lord. Both went and begged forgiveness.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:30 (auto-transcript): “And then, when he started initiating brahmanas, the brahmana community said, what? What? Sutra? Initiatives? Brahmanas? This inner species. All of them,”

Rupa and Sanatana were serving not just a Muslim but a demon — Maharaj links Hussain Shah to Jarasandha, as the Kazi is linked to Kamsa. Yet the king liked Mahaprabhu, even if he did not want to see Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:56 (auto-transcript): “So, Chita Mahaprabhu is teaching us by putting the devotees in different places. Rupal Goswami, Sanatana Goswami, they were working with not just a Muslim but a demon. Hussain Shah, Maharaj, is Jarasandh.”

The time for the brothers' first duty was over; the time had come for their actual work. — “The real business is to preach Krishna consciousness.”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:40 (auto-transcript): “So, Salakta Rupa Gashrami walked with him, because their time to do that first time has past. Now is the time to do the real business. The real business is to preach Krishna consciousness. So, one at a time, Rupa Goswami very carefully left, and he knew that as I had left,…”

Rupa left first and quietly, knowing the king would be pacified while Sanatana remained. He gave half his wealth to brahmanas and Vaishnavas, a quarter to family, and kept a quarter with a grocer, telling Sanatana this money would free him later.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:41 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, he made a perfect plan. He gave 50% of his worth. Today, Brahma, Vaishnavas, 25% family members, 25% he kept with Sanatana Goswami, He kept it with a gross seller, and he told Santana Goswami, you will need this money to free yourself, so I'm keeping it for you here.”

Maharaj stops and asks what is interesting here. The Nawab did not hate Sanatana; he loved him for his service. That very affection is what Sanatana names as his obstacle.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:55 (auto-transcript): “Very interesting. What is interesting? What is interesting? What is interesting Repeat”

Maharaj presses the room for the point and gets silence. Not everyone has ears, he says; the ear that hears will find this very interesting. — “Those who have ears will hear very interesting.”

🎙 Maharaj at 35:40 (auto-transcript): “Not everybody have ears Not everybody Yes So what is this? What is this? This is not ear Those who have ears will hear very interesting. It is not like Swami said,”

A host puts love and affection into a hundred chapatis and insists you finish them — this is how I show my love for you, that is why I invited you home. It is affection, and it is an impediment. — “Our circle of affection can be an impediment.”

🎙 Maharaj at 37:12 (auto-transcript): “100 chapatis could put love and affection. You can see it. If you finish it. That's, Guru De, I want to appreciate my love for you, man. That's why I invited you to my house.”

children.topic: The man of knowledge uses everything
children.note:
There is good in everything in its proper place. The person of knowledge knows how to turn everything to the purpose he stands for, for himself and for everyone; not everyone has this ability, but devotees do.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:31 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, there is good in everything, proper self. It depends on the man of knowledge to know how to use everything for the purpose he stands for. The man of knowledge knows how to use everything for the benefit of the self and everyone. Not everybody has that ability.…”

children.topic: Why the king's love was bad for bhakti
children.note:
Sanatana understands that the king loves him because of his service, and therefore that love will hold him back from Krishna. — “Therefore, his affection for me is not good for my bhakti.”

🎙 Maharaj at 39:14 (auto-transcript): “So Sahaja Goswami knows that the king lost me because of my service. Therefore, his affection for me is not good for my bhakti. If your mother don't want you to be a devotee because of her affection. Is that good for you? Your parents don't want you to be a devotee.”

Maharaj turns the principle on the audience: if your mother does not want you to be a devotee because of her affection, is that good for you?

🎙 Maharaj at 39:37 (auto-transcript): “If your mother don't want you to be a devotee because of her affection. Is that good for you? Your parents don't want you to be a devotee. My son, my husband has died, all my children have died, I still remain alive, because I can see her face. That is the only reason why I…”

Maharaj acts out the mother: husband and other children gone, she lives only to see this one face — stay with me, do not take to Krishna, if you go I will die. Is that hatred? No, it is affection. And it still binds.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:00 (auto-transcript): “My son, my husband has died, all my children have died, I still remain alive, because I can see her face. That is the only reason why I still remain alive. Do you want me to die? Do you want me to die? Do you want me to die? Please. Stay with me. At best,”

A father swears his son will never go abroad; the son goes anyway for Krishna consciousness. For Krishna's service we can go anywhere and do anything; without that purpose, every movement is karma-bandhana.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:24 (auto-transcript): “The father said, no, my son will never go to Europe. My devotees are asking me, have you gone to Europe? Have you come to Europe? Every day, have you gone to Europe? Prabhupada didn't go to Europe. But he went for Krishna Consciousness. When he is now ready for Krishna…”

Narottama was woken at night and told to go to Vrindavan now, not tomorrow, to collect the prema Mahaprabhu had kept for him. He went without looking back. Who loves me more, mother or Krishna? Krishna — so he went. — “Pure devotees, their parents cry.”

🎙 Maharaj at 43:58 (auto-transcript): “Pure devotees, their parents cry. For Nautam doesn't call her, his mother was roaming the whole night, telling her we were searching for him. He lived in the night. Little people called him. Narapan, what are you doing here? We are sleeping here, comfortably. Get up! Go to…”

children.topic: Delayed year after year by love
children.note:
Maharaj recalls how devotees' affection kept delaying a departure from Jagannatha Puri to Vrindavan — too hot now, wait for winter; now the rains; wait again — until the traveller became stubborn, refused the companions who would divert him, and went.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:47 (auto-transcript): “So Santana Goswami to change the system from Jagannath-Puri year after year After years, affection for the devotees, in their home to come. When they want to come to Ghandari, Oh, now it's too hot, Now go to the woods.”

children.topic: 19.15 — Sick at home, awake in Bhagavatam
children.note: Sanatana sends word to the court that he is sick and stops going to the office. Every day he sits at home discussing Bhagavatam — materially sick, spiritually awake. The verse describes the Nawab's reaction.

Hearing his minister is ill, the king sends his physician. Maharaj notes that even a demon appreciates good service and looks after a servant who is sick — something we devotees often fail to do for one another. — “He appreciated the service.”

🎙 Maharaj at 49:08 (auto-transcript): “We continue from there. When he refused to go to the office, the king was like, what is this? He was very sick. As soon as the king had, He is very sick, he will gently send a doctor, please go back to the hospital. See, even though he is a demon, he appreciates that.…”

Vibhisana catches Ravana's spies in Rama's camp and wants them arrested. Rama instead has them shown everything, saying an opponent who knows all your strengths and still prepares has no chance, and lets them go. They run back and tell Ravana that this is the Supreme Person, ready to forgive him — and Ravana rages at them.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:29 (auto-transcript): “He said, doctors, go, go, go, Ravana, deceptive, no, Ravana sent two spies, for Ramachandra, when they came, Vishan was really there, when he saw them coming, ah, those people, they They have brought us spies, even though they have no risk here, with their mystic power, they…”

Ravana and Hussain Shah both appreciate the devotee but do not act on it, which makes them dangerous. We should appreciate and also serve.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:47 (auto-transcript): “But we do not appreciate it, but we do not appreciate it. demon appreciates demon appreciates but they do not do it or they are dangerous very dangerous very dangerous so we should be very dangerous very important demon appreciates demon appreciates so we should be”

Four questions: when to leave a family that resists bhakti, Prabhupada's vision of varnasrama, how to stay undisturbed like Rama, and how to tolerate wrongs happening in front of us.

🎙 Maharaj at 55:02 (auto-transcript): “Maharaj, in this pastime, we see that first, Sanatana Swami was not able to get out of the Havaps, then shine, then eventually he started making excuses and then eventually he flew. So, Maharaj, what is the learning for us that sometimes when we come to Krishna consciousness,…”

children.topic: Q1 · When is it time to leave?
children.note:
Sanatana first could not get out, then made excuses, then fled. When we stay on too long and compromise our Krishna consciousness, at what point do we raise our hands and go?

🎙 Maharaj at 55:02 (auto-transcript): “Maharaj, in this pastime, we see that first, Sanatana Swami was not able to get out of the Havaps, then shine, then eventually he started making excuses and then eventually he flew. So, Maharaj, what is the learning for us that sometimes when we come to Krishna consciousness,…”

children.topic: They left as soon as they were called
children.note:
Maharaj points to Sanatana and to Narottama: once the call came, they left at once. He recalls another devotee who was always detached and whose mother worried how such a boy would ever care for the family.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:35 (auto-transcript): “like Sanadam Goswami, and Chaitanya Mahabharata, As soon as he was told, we just heard it. Shri Narottam Dashthakut He was not able to leave because he was killed. He said, get up now. He said, get up now.”

Maharaj asks what sacrifice we are prepared to make, and answers that the way through is to do as the acaryas did and follow in their footsteps.

🎙 Maharaj at 61:14 (auto-transcript): “That's all who go through acharyas. All of this. That is where we are here. What is the sacrifice we are making for all of us to do? What is the sacrifice we are making for all of us to do? She will free myself from the temple. Do as the deed.”

A devotee asks how Maharaj understands Prabhupada's plan for varnasrama-dharma in ISKCON, especially the varna side, which has been tried with differing opinions. Maharaj mentions Prabhupada's remark that establishing it is half the work still remaining, and sets the topic aside for another time.

🎙 Maharaj at 62:28 (auto-transcript): “One comes in, that is the aspect of Vala Ashram Ghanda. And I'd like to know, because Shila Prabhupada is actually emphasizing it a lot, Shila Prabhupada started this movement so that we can begin to follow according to Baran al-Shram in the harmony. And in the history of…”

children.topic: Q3 · How to never be disturbed?
children.note:
In the spy pastime every devotee was alarmed but Rama stayed composed. How can we stop being shaken by situations?

🎙 Maharaj at 65:16 (auto-transcript): “The question Prabhu is asking that we heard from you that these two spies came to know Lord Ram's camp and every devotee got very disturbed but lord ram was very composed we saw in the whole pastime so what happens in our life in my life i become very disturbed when i when i…”

Rama is the Supreme Lord, so we cannot simply copy him; but by following his teaching and keeping daily practice without a break we gradually cultivate the same steadiness. Don't worry, Maharaj says — stick strictly to the process and the stage will come. — “please maintain your steady practice”

🎙 Maharaj at 66:42 (auto-transcript): “So, please maintain your steady practice, if you maintain your steady practice daily, without a break, eventually we will cultivate this quality. Bhagavan Ramachana is the Supreme Lord, so Allah can you not think about this, because the qualities of God.”
Maharaj cites the Gita: one who is not shaken by happiness or distress becomes fit for liberation. Happiness and distress come together; the goal is to transcend both.

children.topic: Q4 · Wrongs happening in front of me
children.note:
Tolerance is fine, but in family and society so much wrong goes on before my eyes — how do I act?

🎙 Maharaj at 70:48 (auto-transcript): “The question is, you said that this is practice and we will get a tolerance to go above happiness and distress, but in society, in family, I am seeing that so much wrong is going on in front of me.”

Krishna consciousness is about equal vision; if we do not rise above, we stay disturbed. The alternative — cutting off heads — only invites new problems. When we ourselves are transformed we stop being disturbed and can help the others change too. — “If you cut off their head, the problem will end, other things will come inside.”

🎙 Maharaj at 72:28 (auto-transcript): “What does it mean to tolerate, otherwise, cut off their head, so they are not there. If you cut off their head, the problem will end, other things will come inside. So the best thing is that when we become transformed, then we will not be disturbed and we will help those…”

maps.title: Rupa Siksa · Day 03 · Why to Read Bhagavatam?

nodeData.note: CC Madhya 19.17 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Sanatana Gosvami, feigning illness to escape the Nawab's service, is found at home discussing Srimad Bhagavatam with learned brahmanas. From this Maharaj teaches why Bhagavatam is read: it is para-vidya, the knowledge that places Krishna in the heart and ends the confusion of doubt; and it is meant for the envy-free devotee, who is known by consciousness and not by dress. The Q&A takes up distributing Bhagavatam to everyone and the problem of misbehaving devotees. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The verse shows Sanatana Gosvami at home, absorbed with twenty or thirty learned brahmanas in discussing Srimad Bhagavatam. Srila Prabhupada's purport, drawing on Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati Thakura, uses the scene to explain what bhagavata-vicara is and who is fit for it.

Maharaj takes the purport's point from the Mundaka Upanisad: knowledge is of two kinds, para-vidya, the transcendental, and apara-vidya, the material. He quizzes the room on what they have written down — Rig, Yajur, Sama and Atharva Veda with their limbs — and says even these belong to the material side.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:07 (auto-transcript): “They are two kinds of devotion in educational system. One deity which is transcendental, Paravidya, and the other which is material knowledge, attribute material. Material knowledge and spiritual knowledge For the Vedas, the Rig Vedas, Yajur Vedas, Samar Vedas and Bhutia,…”

Within Vedic literature the Vedanta is accepted as para-vidya, and Srimad Bhagavatam is its explanation — the essence of the Vedas. Maharaj recalls Vyasadeva's own question: once this is there, what is the need of any other scripture?

🎙 Maharaj at 27:24 (auto-transcript): “As Vedic literature is concerned, the Vedanta structure is accepted as the Vedya. Srimad Bhagavatam is an explanation of the Paravidya. So Bhagavatam is outside the Vedas. So, the essence of the Vedas is the essence of the Vedas.”

Maharaj quotes the second verse of Srimad Bhagavatam, kim va parair isvarah sadyo hrdy avarudhyate: as soon as one hears this book with faith, the Lord is established in the heart — something the other Vedas by themselves cannot do.

Vyasadeva had compiled and spoken all the Vedas and still was bewildered — not from ignorance but with all that knowledge. Only Srimad Bhagavatam settled his heart. Maharaj uses this to show that knowledge without Bhagavatam leaves one unsatisfied.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:25 (auto-transcript): “That was what happened to Sri Vyasadeva. Aisa hi hua Sri Raghavadeva ji ke saath. Vyasadeva, the world a man came from? Vyashadev brahmit ho gai itana gyan he kushthapna karne ke baad not ignorance alitya se nahi Vyashadev ji ko etana gyan tha his dual demon come from…”

children.topic: Unnecessary affection: the Nawab and Sanatana
children.note:
Maharaj returns to Sanatana Gosvami's resignation from the Nawab's government. The obstacle was affection: the king loved him and would not let him go. Nothing is wrong with affection as such; the affection that holds one back from Krishna consciousness is the unnecessary kind. — “It's not an affectionate, it's an unnecessary affection.”

🎙 Maharaj at 11:18 (auto-transcript): “What was the interesting point? Affection was an impediment.”

Maharaj says one must check whether an affection is favourable to one's spiritual life or whether, in the name of affection, we are forcing our own feelings on another and blocking their path.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:24 (auto-transcript): “a pramadik shish ko to check if our affection is favorable to us that this has been done with our love and love is the Guru's ability to do it or not because we force our feelings to be we force our feelings to be and our So he would not allow me to do that.”

Sanatana could see that managing the kingdom would never give him the opportunity for Krishna consciousness, which he valued higher, and that the king's attachment meant a resignation would never be signed. So he designed a perfect method and declared himself sick. — “Therefore, he designed a perfect method to get sick.”

🎙 Maharaj at 14:31 (auto-transcript): “So now he will not give me the opportunity that I can perform Krishna's Confession. Krishna's Confession is higher than me. Managing the material at night. So, Sonata Goswami was able to see that Sonata Goswami was able to see that because of my belief that my good…”

children.topic: An acarya who was held back too
children.note:
Maharaj gives a parallel from an acarya of our line who, when the time came to retire for bhajan, was retained by those he served and had to find his own way out. The name and details are not clear in the recording.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:43 (auto-transcript): “That is the Shila Bhakti Maha Thakur. Until the end, when it was time to enter the Rizidhan Vajan, when the time came, I was able to do the Rizidhan Vajan. The Nawab sends doctors; they report there is nothing wrong with Sanatana. The ruler comes himself and finds him with the brahmanas. A politician knows everything, Maharaj says: he tells Sanatana, I rule this country through you; if you will not work, I will put you in jail.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:20 (auto-transcript): “So he stopped walking, and he said, immediately, he sent doctors. He is not sick, he is not sick, he is not sick.”

Maharaj asks the room: when was Sanatana put in a cell? Not when he was serving the king, but when he gave it up and was engaged in Krishna consciousness. He adds the case of Gajendra, who was King Indradyumna: the curse fell on him while he was absorbed in worship. The test comes when we take to the path. — “Determination is tested.”

🎙 Maharaj at 19:36 (auto-transcript): “When Sanatana Goswami was doing this nicely He was put in a cell? Was he put in a cell? No. Gajandra Maharaj was good.”

The moment we turn to Krishna, Maya returns to her desk and resumes her work on us. Maharaj recalls Srila Prabhupada's words that taking to Krishna consciousness is a declaration of war.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:21 (auto-transcript): “Why did we not listen? Why did we not listen? She just came now. To resume office. Maya, she took her work. Maya said earlier, She was always working on her work. What is happening? What is happening? She said, She said, She said, She said, She said, She said, She said, She…”

When you begin to clean a room the dust comes up into your eyes. Krishna consciousness is a cleaning process: all the dirt in the heart surfaces first. Keep cleaning and eventually the whole house is clean and beautiful. So do not be disturbed by what comes up.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:04 (auto-transcript): “When you start to clean, you will not get a toss when you start to clean. You will not get a toss when you start to clean. Krishna Mahonamad means that we have started a cleaning process. Krishna Mahonamad means that it means that it is the solution of the evil. Now, all the…”

If we accept the test we pass through it; if we run away from it we only keep running. This is what Maharaj sees Sanatana doing in the verse — carrying on with Bhagavatam under threat.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:44 (auto-transcript): “If you can accept it. If you run away. If you run away. If you run away. Then you will run away. So, God is dancing as what you can do. So, Shila, the Bhagat is dancing as what you can do. They are two kinds of devotion in educational system. One deity which is…”

children.topic: Three who never find the truth
children.note: Maharaj cites Krishna's statement in the Gita that the faithless, the doubting and the ignorant cannot know the truth, and spends time on the doubter — the one whose faithlessness becomes doubt after hearing too many voices.

The rishis each wrote their own darshana, and together the systems create confusion. Maharaj plays the bewildered hearer: one of you must be right, but I cannot tell which, so I believe none of you. — “I don't believe one of you because I don't know which of you is correct”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:25 (auto-transcript): “So these all rishiyo have written their darshan and their philosophy creates confusion and their darshan begins with their darshan Question to me Who is correct? Which reason? I don't believe one of you It's better than anyone else I don't believe one of you because I don't…”

Maharaj says the first thing taught in journalism is: don't believe anyone. A politician's statement tomorrow will differ from today's. Our doubt comes from what we hear, and this is the confusion going on everywhere.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:19 (auto-transcript): “You know, the first lesson, if you go to journalism, The first thing in your thought is don't believe anyone. Don't believe anyone. So he can't talk to eternal his, all their philosophy, what he will publish tomorrow will be different from what he told him. Because you don't…”

He brings it home: today there are two groups of devotees, each claiming to be Prabhupada's. Which one is his? Both. If I follow this side I will hate that side. History repeats itself; there has always been fighting, and time alone shows who stands on the truth.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:11 (auto-transcript): “The people have also become a good person in the world today and have two people who are good. One they are who are the Prabhupadaji and the other they are who are the Prabhupadaji.”

If you are making progress, it is because you have a clear understanding. That clarity is why we hear Bhagavatam. — “Therefore, we should listen to Bhagavata.”

🎙 Maharaj at 37:55 (auto-transcript): “If you are making progress. If you are making progress. If you are making progress. Because you have a clear understanding. This is the time. This is the time. Therefore, we should listen to Bhagavata. Who hears Bhagavata? Who hears Bhagavata? Surrender to Guru. Girmasara.”

Who hears Bhagavatam? One who surrenders to guru and is nirmatsara, free from envy. Anyone can speak and gather many followers; Bhagavatam is different. It is made for a few devotees — non-devotees find no taste in it, devotees relish it. — “Bhagavatam is made for few devotees.”

🎙 Maharaj at 38:17 (auto-transcript): “Who hears Bhagavata? Who hears Bhagavata? Surrender to Guru. Girmasara. Girmasara is Satham. Who is free from? One who is not afraid of envy comes here. You can speak.”
Maharaj notes the Bhagavatam verse the purport cites: it is counted among the Puranas yet is the spotless one, dear to the Vaishnavas.

When the verse says Vaishnava we must understand what makes one. Dhoti, sari, neck beads and tilak can all be worn by a kali-chela, a disciple of Kali in devotee's clothes. Consciousness makes the difference, and what is inside comes out. — “What is inside can come out.”

🎙 Maharaj at 40:21 (auto-transcript): “When we say Vaishnava, we should understand the category of Vaishnava. To put on this dress or carry a dress To put on this shirt With the collar In the leg It's nice The collar and the collar It's too much No one's not to wear it With your risque Your collar That's good…”

children.topic: A fool is known when he speaks
children.note:
Prabhupada's saying: a fool is not known until he opens his mouth. Likewise a devotee is known when he explains Bhagavatam — what is in the heart shows in the speaking.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:53 (auto-transcript): “So Prabhupada said, a fool is not alone. Until he speaks. Until he speaks. Similarly. We know a deity. When only God. When there is an explanation of Bhagavad, Bhagavad, Bhagavad, Bhagavad, Bhagavad, Bhagavad, Bhagavad, Bhagavad, Bhagavad.”

Maharaj draws a picture from Krishna's birth: Kamsa in his palace is full of anxiety, while Vasudeva and Devaki, surrounded by so many problems, are not disturbed at all. Bhagavatam shows this to reveal the devotee's nature and to differentiate devotee from non-devotee. — “That they are fixed. They are not disturbed.”

🎙 Maharaj at 44:48 (auto-transcript): “Back through these duties are no longer. Gamsa is on your palace. Vashidev is back behind the piece. Gamsa is on your palace. Gamsa is on your palace. Gamsa is on your palace. Gamsa is on your palace. Vashidev is on your palace. Behind his palace Behind his palace Behind his…”

A short question before the purport is finished, then two longer ones after the class: why distribute Bhagavatam to everyone if it is for the pure, and what to make of devotees who wear the dress but not the character.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:41 (auto-transcript): “Do you have any questions? Yes, please tell me! How is the Quran-Purana? How is the Quran-Purana-Bhagvad? How is the Quran-Purana-Bhagvad? How many asur and asur, asur and asur are the laws of the Quran? Yes, I know. I want to give you an answer. You have said that the…”

A devotee asks about Bhagavatam's standing among the Puranas and about the demons it describes. The recording is too rough to follow the exchange; Maharaj's answer touches on Krishna living among the asuras and defers the rest to the next day.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:45 (auto-transcript): “How is the Quran-Purana? How is the Quran-Purana-Bhagvad? How is the Quran-Purana-Bhagvad? How many asur and asur, asur and asur are the laws of the Quran? Yes, I know. I want to give you an answer. You have said that the Bhagavata is a lie. Krishna never came to me with…”

children.topic: Q2 · Why give a book meant for the pure to everyone?
children.note:
Prabhupada asked his disciples to distribute Srimad Bhagavatam to millions, yet the book itself says it is for the envy-free saints and pure devotees. So why are we discussing and distributing it?

🎙 Maharaj at 53:05 (auto-transcript): “Question is that Srimad Bhagavatam is not written as a nirmash-saranaam-chatam. Srimad Bhagavatam is for the nine Suddha-bhaktham which are used by the two people. Why are we discussing?”

children.topic: A chance for us, nourishment for devotees
children.note:
Bhagavatam is given to those who are not yet devotees to give them a chance, and it is for those who already are. It prepares us gradually and we enjoy it gradually; there is no mistake in offering it widely. — “It is also for those who are already devotees.”

🎙 Maharaj at 54:01 (auto-transcript): “We mentioned that Bhagavatam is for now to give us a chance. It is also for those who are already devotees. Because, I told you, they had to give you a choice of it. So, what do you think? But what has, they prepare us gradually and enjoy it gradually.”

The devotee does not forget the material contamination he himself came from; seeing others in it he thinks, let me help them. So we take care of our own hearts and also reach out. This is what Prabhupada did — Bhagavatam in every home.

🎙 Maharaj at 55:39 (auto-transcript): “He didn't forget. Material interrogation. I am forgetting the same thing. I am forgetting the same thing. But the same thing. But I am very sure that I am not physically like me. Let me help them. So let me help them. So, this is our punishment, that we take care of in our…”

Three questions on the kali-chela point: why does Krishna allow devotees in tilak and dress to misbehave; does it not suggest the holy name and deity are not purifying enough, and how do we protect ourselves; and what hope is there for those innocently following such people?

🎙 Maharaj at 57:22 (auto-transcript): “My question is to you. You mentioned this aspect of Kalichella, where devotees, Thilak, Sahri and so on, They chanting by Krishna, but they may not be exactly representing Krishna or purity. Three questions from that aspect. One is, why does Krishna allow this to happen? Why…”

Maharaj answers with Balarama, who loved Duryodhana, made so many plans for him, arranged family ties, trained him fully and gave him position — and Duryodhana was still killed by Bhima. The Lord gives every opportunity and lets things take their course; time exposes the truth.

🎙 Maharaj at 60:14 (auto-transcript): “The most important thing is that Balram Ji is a very precious person. Balram Ji is the best time for Balram Ji. Balram Ji loves him. He has so many plans. He has so many plans. He has so much peace. Like making arrangements for him to marry. Like making arrangements for him…”

children.topic: We think we are very good
children.note:
Why does it happen even with Krishna present? Because we think ourselves very good. The remedy Maharaj gives is to go on learning and to keep seeing oneself as a fool; then one gradually becomes a pure devotee.

🎙 Maharaj at 61:51 (auto-transcript): “If Krishna comes, why do we all do this? We think we are very good. Let us give up this message.”

Newcomers are innocent and know nothing, but if they are sincere and want Krishna, Krishna will bring them to the right place and send the right people. The cheaters cannot be stopped — this is Kali-yuga — and one pays a price for being misled.

🎙 Maharaj at 64:21 (auto-transcript): “So, the second question is that the second question was, is that the new devotees come, who are born and born, do not know anything and will be born for them. children.topic: Why we land in the wrong place
children.note:
Prabhupada says we are unlucky, unfortunate and misguided. Wanting Krishna, we first go to the wrong place because our heart is wrong. Did the Gosvamis have to? No, because they were not wrong. — “We are wrong people, so we have to go to the wrong place.”

🎙 Maharaj at 66:55 (auto-transcript): “Prabha says, we are lucky and fortunate and misguided. And Prabha says, we are so lucky that even if we want to take the Lord God, If we want to go to Krishna, then we will have to go to the wrong place. Why do we have to go to the wrong place? Of course we are. Because our…”

children.topic: In Vrindavan, yet look at us
children.note:
We are here in Vrindavan, but look at what we do — anger, gossip even in the class. Maharaj says our own activities disqualify us, so we do not get the fruit we could.

🎙 Maharaj at 67:56 (auto-transcript): “We are here, but look at the things we do. Take a little, please see what we are doing. You see the things we do. We are to ourselves.”

maps.title: Rupa Siksa · Day 04 · Why Demons Become Kings

nodeData.note: CC Madhya 19.18–19 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Sanatana Gosvami and the brahmanas rise to honour Nawab Hussain Shah, and Maharaj asks why a demon holds such a post at all: power is Krishna's grace, given for a purpose, and for the uncontrolled it becomes the instrument of their own ruin. The story of King Nahusa, raised to Indra's throne and cursed by Agastya, shows how; the class then asks how a devotee should view leaders who misuse their position. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Maharaj reads the setting: Sanatana Gosvami, a minister of Nawab Hussain Shah of Bengal, is studying Srimad-Bhagavatam in an assembly of brahmanas when the Nawab himself suddenly walks in.

From the purport Maharaj gives the historical frame — the Muslim ruler of Bengal in whose service Sanatana Gosvami worked, with the dates of his reign — read also in Hindi for the audience.

🎙 Maharaj at 07:01 (auto-transcript): “The pastor and the pastor named Allahuddin Sayyid Khusain Shah, He has been taught in Bengal in 1424. Sanatana Goswami has been taught in 1424 in the 14th century of Srimad Bhagavad. While Sanatana Goswami was taught in Srimad Bhagavad, in assembly of the Brahmans,”

children.topic: 19.18 — The brahmanas rise for the Nawab
children.note: The verse describes the brahmanas and Sanatana Gosvami standing up and respectfully seating the Nawab when he appears; the purport explains why a non-Hindu ruler receives this honour.

children.topic: An exalted post is Krishna's grace
children.note: Maharaj reads how an exalted executive position is to be seen as something obtained by the Lord's grace, and takes the audience to the Gita verses on Krishna as the source of every opulent and powerful manifestation and as the strength of the strong.

The scholars honoured the Nawab not for his character or religion but because the power he carried represents a fraction of Krishna's power.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:09 (auto-transcript): “The lame Brahmana scholars should respect one of our Christian child because he represented the function of Krishna's power. For a demon to be in power, may Krishna authorize it. Krishna authorizes at his point of power.”

No demon can sit in power without the Lord permitting it; the respect, Maharaj says, is therefore real and not mere diplomacy.

children.topic: They knew he was only a jiva
children.note:
Sanatana Gosvami and the brahmanas knew very well the Nawab was an ordinary living entity, yet they recognised that his position existed for a purpose, and so saw it differently from the man.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:13 (auto-transcript): “Sanatana Goswami and the Brahmanas recognize that. So the spirit of Al-Khariya is a different place to see. Even though they know very well that is a Jeeva. It has a position. It means that it is for purpose.”

Maharaj turns the purport into a question for the room: if power comes from Krishna, what could be the reason demons are put in power at all?

🎙 Maharaj at 15:02 (auto-transcript): “What could be the reason why demons are here? Because why demons are in position? Nobody will be happy, because of their atrocities. So look at his children.”

Maharaj first rules out the obvious answer — a demonic ruler is not there to make the citizens happy, because their atrocities make everyone miserable. — “Nobody will be happy, because of their atrocities.”

🎙 Maharaj at 15:20 (auto-transcript): “Nobody will be happy, because of their atrocities. So look at his children.”

The example closest to hand: Kamsa ruled this very land of Mathura-Vrindavan. Was there a purpose in that? Maharaj suggests the citizens' own karma and the demon's own are both being served.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:06 (auto-transcript): “We saw Kamsayas king here. Is it a purpose? A citizen needs that. For their own, their own, current. And for the demonic king. Responsible for this.”

Maharaj's answer: to punish someone who has not controlled his senses, give him a big position. Without self-control the position itself destroys him — and that is how so many personalities in history have fallen. — “He will destroy himself.”

🎙 Maharaj at 17:51 (auto-transcript): “But to punish somebody who has not controlled other beings or her senses, give the test a big possession. He will destroy himself. So, because he doesn't have control of the essence, what do you mean? It would destroy them. We have so many, so many personalities who did this.”

Maharaj illustrates the principle with Nahusa, a human king of this earth who was raised to the post of Indra and lost everything through pride and lust.

With Indra's throne vacant, the demigods requested Nahusa, a pious king and not a demigod, to take the post. He refused several times, saying only Indra could do it, but on their insistence he accepted — and the moment he sat on the throne the change began.

children.note:
Coming back to today, Maharaj notes that we see leaders of poor character misusing public property everywhere, and asks how a devotee is to perceive them.

children.note:
Should we respect them because the position is Krishna's power, or be angry with them for abusing what Krishna gave? Maharaj puts both sides to the audience. — “The question is, how should we have perception of them?”

children.note:
If we are able to correct something, we may; if we cannot, we should not take revenge or agitate ourselves. Krishna will do his own work in his own way.

children.note:

A story: a girl brings a boy to her guru and says she likes him. The guru is expected only to approve — the decision was already taken, and the guru's role has been reduced to a stamp.

maps.title: Rupa Siksa · Day 05 · Being Purpose Driven

nodeData.note: CC Madhya 19.20–40 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Sanatana Gosvami resigns from the Nawab's service, is imprisoned, and Rupa Gosvami writes to him with a plan and money to escape; Rupa and Anupama reach Prayag and find Mahaprabhu at the Bindu Madhava temple surrounded by vast crowds. Maharaj draws the lesson of a devotee who has fixed his purpose and acts on it, and in the questions he discusses how Sanatana and the Muslim Nawab could be so close, and why we remain unfortunate when we fill our mouths with karma rather than Krishna's name. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: 19.20–28 — Sanatana resigns; the Nawab arrests him
children.note: The reading covers Sanatana Gosvami's conversation with Nawab Hussain Shah: Sanatana will no longer serve, the Nawab pleads with him as an elder brother would, Sanatana answers with a joke, and the Nawab finally has him arrested.

Sanatana tells the Nawab plainly that he can expect no further work from him and should find someone else. The Nawab, who had already sent his physician to check whether Sanatana was really ill, becomes angry.

🎙 Maharaj at 03:24 (auto-transcript): “You can no longer expect any sins from me. Please arrange for someone who has obtained the Because you are the person who is the person who is the person who is the person who is the person.”

children.topic: The Nawab speaks as a brother
children.note:
The purport explains that the Nawab treated Sanatana like a younger brother. He says, in effect: I am busy plundering other states and destroying people like a meat-eater, so you, my younger brother, should look after the state — how else will things continue?

🎙 Maharaj at 09:46 (auto-transcript): “It is said that the relationship between the Nawab of Bengals and Sarantan Goswami was very good. The Nawab used to consider Sarantan Goswami as his younger brother. And when Salateng Kusum ensured a very strong intention for desire, then I was feeling familiar and affection.…”

Sanatana answers in the same light, family tone: you are the independent ruler, act as you like, and punish whoever is at fault. The sense is that if the Nawab is going to behave like a plunderer, he should go ahead — and dismiss Sanatana from his post.

🎙 Maharaj at 11:33 (auto-transcript): “Sanatan Goswami also replied in an eating and joking way. Essentially, he told the Nawa, My dear brother, you are the independent ruler of God. You can act whatever way you like. If someone commits a fault, you can punish him accordingly. Sanatang Goswami was saying that…”
The Nawab arrests Sanatana Gosvami and keeps him in custody. The Hindi passage adds Sanatana's reply that the Nawab is free to give pain to whomever he wants.
While Sanatana sits in prison, Sri Caitanya Mahaprabhu departs from Jagannatha Puri towards Vrindavan. Rupa Gosvami's two messengers return from Puri with the news that the Lord has already left.

Rupa Gosvami immediately writes to his imprisoned brother: we two brothers are setting out to meet Mahaprabhu, and you must somehow get free and join us. The 'two brothers' here are Rupa and their younger brother Anupama.

children.topic: Ten thousand coins with a grocer
children.note: Rupa has left a deposit of ten thousand coins with a grocer and tells Sanatana to use that money to get out of prison. The wealth Rupa divided on Day 01 is here put to its intended use: freeing a devotee for service.

Rupa Gosvami and Anupama set off to see Mahaprabhu and are overjoyed at Prayag to learn that He is there. Mahaprabhu visits the Bindu Madhava temple with many hundreds of thousands of people following Him.
The younger brother was a great devotee whose actual name was Sri Vallabha; Anupama Mallika was the name he was given.

children.topic: Bindu Madhava: a small temple, a huge crowd
children.note:
Maharaj pauses on the scene at Prayag. The Bindu Madhava temple we see today is tiny and stands on the bank of the Ganga; hundreds of thousands of people could never have fitted there. He asks the room how this could be.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:57 (auto-transcript): “Shri Tata Mahapuram went to see the temple of Vindu Mara and many hundreds of thousands of people followed him just to meet him. The Vindu Mara temple was small. There are hundreds of thousands of people who followed him just a job. A very small place.”

children.topic: Then it was big, now it is small
children.note:
Maharaj's answer is that the temple of Mahaprabhu's time was large; what stands now is recent. The old sites of the Lord's pastimes have shrunk or been rebuilt, so we should not judge the past by the present building.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:32 (auto-transcript): “The temple will be big. At that time, the temple is big. Now it is small. There are thousands of people who have come from here. And the temple? What do you see now? This one is recent.”

Maharaj gives a parallel from Varanasi, where Mahaprabhu stayed at the house of Candrasekhara. Today that place too is very small, though in the Lord's time it accommodated everyone who came.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:35 (auto-transcript): “Chandra Shekhar says, how she is supposed to start? Chandra Shekhar, his house is here. He is very small. He is very small. He is very small. He is very small. He is very small. He is a queen shekhar. He is a queen shekhar. He is a descendant. Pagotto”

Maharaj contrasts the Nawab, absorbed in fighting and in advancing his own family, with Sanatana Gosvami, who had served that king but whose mind had already turned to his real purpose. Once Sanatana fixes his aim, the king's affection and the king's anger both fail to move him.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:08 (auto-transcript): “So, Sanatana Goswami and the King has come together to help his family. He was very busy, disturbing people. The King was doing the work in order to improve his family. He was not managing energy. He also doesn't have any things in the King. In Sanatana Goswami, he was doing…”

Sanatana's calm answer to the Nawab — do what you like, I cannot continue — is the mark of someone who has settled the question inside. There is no bargaining left, only the next step. — “He has already decided what to do.”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:36 (auto-transcript): “He has already decided what to do. Our dream was about to make ourselves a miracle. So, that the miracle was made. And there was no position in our medical occupation. So, if we do all the work from the Krišnaanamate, we have to do all the weaknesses.”

children.topic: Without Krishna consciousness we are weak
children.note:
If everything we do is for material position and family, we are left with our weaknesses, because without Krishna consciousness we are not strong. Awareness of this is itself the beginning of strength.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:59 (auto-transcript): “So, if we do all the work from the Krišnaanamate, we have to do all the weaknesses. Because we are not strong. If we are not aware of this, we are not aware of it. If we are not aware of it, we are not aware of it.”

Sanatana worries about how to leave the kingdom; it is his brother's letter that gives him both the destination and the means. A purpose-driven devotee is helped by other devotees at the right moment.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:22 (auto-transcript): “Guru Goswami has told him that if he will leave the kingdom so he will give him the Lord to the Pundabas so that he will give him the kingdom to the king so that he will give him the Lord to the God Known”

Prayag stands at the meeting of two rivers, yet in this age people there were not able to pray or chant properly; Mahaprabhu, arriving there, inundated everyone with the holy name. Maharaj praises this as very, very good.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:24 (auto-transcript): “In the kishnahs, when these kishnahs were not able to pray, the kishnahs were not able to pray in the kishnahs. Very very good. Very good. Located at the conference of two rivers. Jamanan and they don't have the power to pray. But although in this universe we are not able to…”

Three questions from the floor: Sanatana's friendship with the Nawab across two religions, Rupa's advice to use crooked means to escape, and the power of chanting Mahaprabhu's own name.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:15 (auto-transcript): “If you allow me, I can ask, the first thing is, seeing this relationship between Alta Nuswami and the Muhammad Hussein, that is an intimate one, although now”

children.topic: Q1 · Vaishnava and Muslim, yet intimate friends
children.note:
A devotee asks how Sanatana Gosvami, practising Vaishnavism, and Hussain Shah, practising Islam, could have such an intimate relationship. Maharaj restates it: how could Sanatana and the king understand each other when they were such different people?

🎙 Maharaj at 36:15 (auto-transcript): “If you allow me, I can ask, the first thing is, seeing this relationship between Alta Nuswami and the Muhammad Hussein, that is an intimate one, although now”

children.topic: It is a question of consciousness
children.note:
Maharaj turns the question back on the audience — why are you so interested in that? — and answers that what joins or divides people is consciousness. Sanatana knows, and the Nawab also knows; both are in knowledge. — “Because they are worshipping the same person in different ways.”

🎙 Maharaj at 38:27 (auto-transcript): “Our consciousness. How do you think about yourself? Standing up. How are you standing? How are you doing? To push me. Our consciousness. Why are you so interested in that? I am so proud of you. You are so proud of me. My Krishna is very good. And many people are very good.”

children.topic: Krishna gives religion to each as needed
children.note:
It is not Krishna's mistake that there are different religions. Krishna knows what each of us needs, and He gave religion accordingly. Maharaj adds that he himself came from a Christian family. — “I came from a Christian family.”

🎙 Maharaj at 42:08 (auto-transcript): “Krishna knows That we all need Each of us This is why He gave religion for He gave religion for He gave religion for No No No No No No No No No No No No No I came from a Christian family.”

children.topic: Q2 · Crooked means for a right end?
children.note:
Rupa Gosvami effectively told Sanatana to bribe his way out of prison, knowing it was the only way, while otherwise asking him to act rightly. In practice, the devotee asks, may we also sometimes take such 'different ways'?

🎙 Maharaj at 43:53 (auto-transcript): “Srila Rupa Goswami basically told Satya Goswami to cheat or do that. He knew that the only way he could get it off his head was through some crooked ways. But at the same time, we were asked him to be the harvest in the right ways. So in a practical way, how can we apply some…”

Maharaj's answer, as far as it can be heard: being freed means being free to chant and serve; Sanatana Gosvami was living for Krishna, and the money went to that end. (See review.)

🎙 Maharaj at 47:23 (auto-transcript): “So, you could be free means to chance in the same way. He did not give breath because I met my mom. If you give breath, To avoid being punished, we give gladly, avoid being punished for doing something wrong in the sea. If we have people who are living in the water, we are…”

children.topic: Q3 · Is Mahaprabhu's name more powerful?
children.note:
The devotee notes it was said that chanting the name of Caitanya Mahaprabhu is more powerful, since He gave love of God freely; people at Prayag were chanting His name. Should we then chant Mahaprabhu's name?

🎙 Maharaj at 44:48 (auto-transcript): “During the conversation, it said that the holy name of the preacher is more powerful than the father. They said that Chidamapro gave the love of God through Sohi, but then they were chanting Chidamapro's name. So it means we should dance now of God and then quicker on those…”

Maharaj asks who said that, and answers that it is a path, but Krishna's name is the goal we are chanting towards. (Answer partly inaudible; see review.)

🎙 Maharaj at 46:51 (auto-transcript): “Who said that? It is a path. But Krishna's name, Krishna's name, is the Pranijas. So, you could be free means to chance in the same way. He did not give breath because I met my mom.”

Maharaj describes the people who pressed around Mahaprabhu — many were religious, and even small children, who challenged Him: who is your teacher? In the crush at the ghat every day heads and limbs were broken, yet people still came to pray to Him.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:42 (auto-transcript): “Those are the people who are gods or quests with Chaitanya Mahabhrao that were not with Fan durable.”

Maharaj contrasts the great souls whose mouths say Krishna, Krishna with us, whose mouths are full of karma — chance, luck, karma. That, he says, is why we are not fortunate; Caitanya Mahaprabhu knows this about us. — “This is why we are not fortunate.”

🎙 Maharaj at 52:46 (auto-transcript): “Karma. Karma is very good. What? Karma. So, we pray to you. You see, the master. You see, the master says, Krishna, Krishna. Krishna, Krishna. But here we say, Krishna Jantar, no, chance, chance, chance, chance, chance, chance. Jantar, Jantar, Jantar, Jantar, Jantar, Jantar,…”

maps.title: Rupa Siksa · Day 06 · The Most Munificent Lord

nodeData.note: CC Madhya 19.41–54 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Rupa Gosvami and Anupama meet Caitanya Mahaprabhu at Prayag: they watch his ecstatic kirtan from a distance, fall at his feet in the home of a Deccan brahmana, and are embraced and blessed. Maharaj draws out what real darshan is, why being a devotee outweighs any birth or learning, and how Mahaprabhu's mercy makes even those who do not know the mantra dance to it. A long Q&A covers separation from the guru, punishment in Kali-yuga, what to share with one's spiritual master, and judging a guru by his disciples. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Maharaj picks up from text 41. Sanatana Gosvami has resolved never to return to government work; he is imprisoned, and the money Rupa Gosvami left for him is used to get himself out of jail. The brothers then set out, expecting to meet Mahaprabhu on his way through Prayag.

🎙 Maharaj at 02:31 (auto-transcript): “We stopped. Sanatana Goswami had decided not to work again.”

In Hindi Maharaj explains the brothers' plan: Mahaprabhu is travelling this way and they will find him at Prayag, at the Bindu Madhava temple, where thousands have gathered at the Ganga.

🎙 Maharaj at 04:50 (auto-transcript): “Aaj aayye vrindavan. Kkyo bhaagawan chetanya maha parbu is raastay aane waal hai. Aare haom ko milenge. Pryaga. Pryag par. Sitiya maha parbu vachin. Chetanya maha parbu vanasi mein thay. Aare pryag mein. Bindu madho mandir par. There were a lot of thousands of people in Ganga…”

children.topic: A lesson at the cremation ghat
children.note:
Maharaj turns to the cremation ground at Prayag: go to the smashan and watch, and you will see how beautiful this body really is. In Krishna-bhakti, he says, the body is already 'dry' — the attachment has gone before the fire comes.

🎙 Maharaj at 06:05 (auto-transcript): “What is for? Cremation. Cremation. For the last one, he used to use the stone. We should go to Samsan's house. We will see him. We will see how beautiful our body is. We will see how beautiful our body is. We will see him. We will do that by doing it. If it is like plastic,”

children.topic: 19.41 — Watching the Lord from a distance
children.note: The verse describes the two brothers standing apart from the huge crowd and seeing Mahaprabhu absorbed in ecstasy.

Maharaj says the Lord's devotees tremble in ecstasy just on hearing the word Vrindavan, and all the more on seeing the Lord himself. That is darshan — not inspecting the jewels and decorations on the altar. — “That is what is called darshan.”

🎙 Maharaj at 09:05 (auto-transcript): “Lord even to hear to your devotees the moment they hear Brindavan you only see them they're going to be trembling in ecstasy And when they see the Lord.”

children.topic: Everything reminds a devotee of Krishna
children.note:
Maharaj lists what throws a devotee into ecstasy: a peacock feather, a dark rain cloud, a tamal tree, a flute, yellow cloth, cows, the Yamuna, a hill — and above all other Vaishnavas. Devotees seeing devotees is itself darshan.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:45 (auto-transcript): “Like Morpank, Morg, Ghanshyam, Badal, Tamal Vrach, Venu, Yellow Dress, Gaya, Jamuna, Parvata, Vaishnavas.”
These verses describe Mahaprabhu loudly chanting Hari's name and dancing with raised arms, the whole crowd joining and standing astonished, and the author confessing he cannot describe it properly.

Mahaprabhu is taken home for meals by an acquaintance, a brahmana from the Deccan. There Rupa Gosvami and Anupama find him sitting alone; with straw between their teeth they fall flat, rise, recite verses and fall again, overwhelmed.
Mahaprabhu, delighted, calls Rupa Gosvami to him and says Krishna's mercy cannot be described, because it has lifted the two brothers out of the well of material life.
Mahaprabhu recites Krishna's own words: a scholar of all four Vedas without devotion is not his, while a devotee born among dog-eaters is dear to him and worthy of every respect.

Maharaj boils the verse down: one may be a great Vedic pandit, but what matters most in our life is to become a devotee. — “The most important thing in our life is to be a devotee.”

🎙 Maharaj at 24:14 (auto-transcript): “Krishna said. One may be a Vedic Vidwan Pandit. The most important thing in our life is to be a devotee.”
Maharaj notes that this verse is quoted from the Hari-bhakti-vilasa, the book Sanatana Gosvami himself would later compile — the Lord speaks to the brothers from a text one of them will write.
After reciting the verse Mahaprabhu embraces both brothers and places his feet on their heads; they fold their hands and, in great humility, offer prayers.
The famous namo maha-vadanyaya prayer, read in Sanskrit, Hindi and English: Krishna himself, in Radharani's golden complexion, freely distributing love of Krishna.

children.topic: 19.54 — Making the mad world mad with love
children.note: The second prayer: the whole world, mad with ignorance, is cured by being made mad in a different way — with the nectar of love of God. We take shelter of that Lord whose activities are wonderful.

Maharaj repeats the last line of the prayer again and again — Mahaprabhu's activities are wonderful — and points to the chanting that followed from them. — “Chaitanya Mahaprabhu's activities are wonderful.”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:14 (auto-transcript): “Shri Krishna Mahaprabhu's activities are wonderful. Bavina Lila-mitsa. Shri Krishna Mahaprabhu's activities are wonderful. Chaitanya Mahaprabhu's activities are wonderful. That was so very chanting.”

children.topic: Hare Krishna where no one knew it
children.note:
Everyone had forgotten Hari, Maharaj says, and there was no way out — yet now the holy name is heard even in places where there was not a single devotee. He asks the room what this is, and answers: this is mercy. — “This is mercy.”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:01 (auto-transcript): “Hurry, hurry, hurry, everybody forgot and that's messy and that's messy there is no way there is no way”

Maharaj recalls a kirtan in a public park with a large crowd, where people on one side danced to Hare Krishna without knowing what the mantra means. He asks: do they get any benefit? They do. Some try to imitate the devotees, some just dance — and that too is Mahaprabhu's mission at work. — “They have benefit or not?”

🎙 Maharaj at 34:04 (auto-transcript): “He is from the motor park garage with so many people. We went to the park where many people went to the park. So, the devotees were having that. The motopathic food, they are one side of the doctor. They are always expecting. One day, they don't understand the meaning of the…”

Four questions, all following up on Maharaj's earlier classes: separation from the guru, punishment in Kali-yuga, openness with one's spiritual master, and judging a guru by his disciples.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:50 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna Maharaj, I have a question regarding one of your previous classes on Bhagavad Gita 2.11. so my question is that you mentioned that we have never seen the soul of any living entity so there's no point in lamenting so how should we react when our spiritual master…”

children.topic: Q1 · When the spiritual master departs
children.note:
A devotee recalls Maharaj's Bhagavad-gita 2.11 class — we have never seen anyone's soul, so there is no cause for lamentation — and asks: then how should we feel and react when our spiritual master leaves this world?

🎙 Maharaj at 35:50 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna Maharaj, I have a question regarding one of your previous classes on Bhagavad Gita 2.11. so my question is that you mentioned that we have never seen the soul of any living entity so there's no point in lamenting so how should we react when our spiritual master…”

children.topic: We saw his life, not his soul
children.note:
Maharaj grants the point — we have not seen the guru's soul — but we have seen what he did: how he changed our lives, the realisation and vision he gave us, his activities. The guru–disciple bond is spiritual, and that is the real ground of our feeling of separation.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:01 (auto-transcript): “Even though we have not seen him, we have seen this. We have not seen the Guru's soul. The Guru has preached our lives and preached our lives. That is why Guru Shishikha is an adhyatmik. The realization. The vision that he gave to us. In him.”

children.topic: Will you go with him? Not yet decided
children.note:
Maharaj teases the questioner about whether he would follow his guru out of the world, then turns to the scriptural rule for a chaste wife: following the husband is recommended only when she is free of her duties — small children and dependants come first. Serve out your responsibilities before you think of leaving.
