In Vrindavan both opulence and knowledge are absent and only prema is prominent. Yashoda, Nanda and the Brajavasis never offer Krishna obeisances; vatsalya-prema is complete and Yogamaya plays fully. Therefore, Maharaj concludes, Vrindavan is the greatest. — “Therefore, Vrindavan is the greatest.”

🎙 Maharaj at 19:20 (auto-transcript): “Opulence, knowledge is absent in Vindavan. Prema is prominent. So, Madhya Svata will not offer business to Krishna. That's why we see that Yashvada Mahi never does God's name. Radha Mahara will not have obeisance. Nandam also never does God's name. Because... Because...…”

When Uddhava arrived, Krishna was physically present here as Vrajendra-nandana, hidden, while Yadukumara stayed in Dwarka. Scripture says Krishna went to Mathura and Dwarka, but Maharaj insists he is always here, sometimes covered, always manifest.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:01 (auto-transcript): “When Uddhava came here, Krishna was physically present there. He was physically present there. Of course, we should understand. Krishna Dwaraka is Yadukumara, Yadukumara, and Prajanda Nandan, Yadukumara. We should know that Bhagavan Krishna is in the form of Yadukumara, not…”

Maharaj asks whether we remember that Uddhava, sent by Krishna, forgot Yadukumara once he came here — because Vrajendra-nandana is present in Vrindavan incognito. — “But Krishna is always here.”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:11 (auto-transcript): “So when Uddhav came here, sent by Krishna, he forgot Yadukumar. Do you remember? That somebody sent him here, he forgot. Why? Because Brajanda Nandan is here. Incognito. Because people, you will hear our scriptures.”

Citing the Brahma-samhita verse read in the purport, Maharaj explains that those whose eyes are anointed with the ointment of love of God — the santas — see Syamasundara, black and beautiful, in their hearts always, not sometimes.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:48 (auto-transcript): “see those whose eyes have been anointed with the ointment the ointment of love of Godhead I said it's an ointment So, people who are given to God's love, who are the most rich, who are the most rich, who are always seen in God's love, they are always sent. They are called…”

children.topic: Then why do the Brajavasis cry?
children.note:
Maharaj puts a question the audience must answer: if Krishna is always here and the Brajavasis always see him, why do they lament? Narada went to Dwarka and told Krishna his friends were paralysed, alive yet dead, and the gopis told Uddhava his master was unreliable — take me to him, don't touch my feet.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:13 (auto-transcript): “so if it is true that the Brajabasis always see Krishna all that time Bhagawan nirantar why were they lamenting he must answer my question Why are you lamenting? Why are you lamenting? Naradamuni went to Dwaraka. Naradamuni went to Dwaraka. And he told Krishna. And Krishna…”

Maharaj's analogy: sugarcane juice boiling from the oven. You taste it, you burn your tongue and mouth, your lips blister — and you want to drink again. That, he says, is Vrindavan.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:41 (auto-transcript): “Have you tested it? Do you have boiled, hot sugarcane juice? I will taste it before. Do you have to drink it very hot? Very hot. It's from the oven. You taste it. Do you have to drink it? You have to taste it. Do you have to taste it?”

In Vrindavan poison is nectar, the forest is home, home is the forest, an enemy is a friend; the quarrel is a loving exchange. This is where we are sitting, and it is going on eternally. — “Poison is nectar.”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:28 (auto-transcript): “This is Vrindavan. Poison is nectar. Nectar is nectar. Nectar is nectar. Forest is a home. Home is forest. A home is one. One is enemy. An enemy is a friend. It's a quarrel-votative course. Coral, what are they doing?”

A devotee suggests Krishna is present as Supersoul. Maharaj rejects it — there is no Supersoul in Vrindavan; the loving exchanges, even the quarrels, need his personal presence. — “No Supersoul in Vrindavan”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:06 (auto-transcript): “of these blurry exchanges are not present. It couldn't even fight. There is quarrel without a call. It wouldn't be fight. It's present, but not, like, in his charms in the form. As what? It's critical. As super-soul and... No super-soul and... ...but never. So Prabhuji is…”

Devotees offer answers: Krishna hides to raise love in separation to a higher level; Rupa Gosvami's chapter on compatible and incompatible rasas in Nectar of Devotion; the Brajavasis want more and more, like the burning juice; and prema-vaicittya, feeling separation while the beloved sits beside you.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:22 (auto-transcript): “Krishna is hiding to increase the lovingness exchanges. Krishna is hiding to increase, to bring to a high level that separation, love in separation. So Prabhu Ji says that Krishna is hidden here so that his love can be greater. Krishna is hiding. Krishna is hiding. And he is…”

children.topic: They are cheating us: that is rasa
children.note:
Maharaj's own answer: Krishna is present and the Brajavasis are simply enjoying themselves. Like actors in a drama, they are cheating us; there is no real separation between them — it does not exist — but this is how prema is maintained. — “they are cheating us”

🎙 Maharaj at 36:56 (auto-transcript): “Krishna is present again. They are simply enjoying themselves. they are simply enjoying themselves they are cheating us you know when people play drama”

Radha and Krishna sit together openly on a swing, no Jatila in sight. A bumblebee takes Radharani's face for a lotus and will not be driven off; when she covers her face with her hands the bee sees more lotuses. Disturbed, Krishna sends Madhumangala to chase it away.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:32 (auto-transcript): “Radha and Krishna sitting together, enjoying their swing, they are sitting together, together, not separate, they are free, and they are very open, Jattila is not there, they are very open, they are enjoying it, Radha and Krishna fell dead and fell on the ground. Why? Because…”

Madhumangala returns announcing that Madhu is gone. Radharani hears it as Madhusudana gone, and though Krishna is sitting right there she falls to the ground; seeing her, Krishna falls too. The place is therefore known as Prema Sarovara.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:24 (auto-transcript): “He came back. He came back. He was gone. Madhu was gone. Srimadiradrani Yes, and when she was thinking because she was thinking that her friend has left her but now she was sitting and she fell Srimadiradrani and she was looking at her Krishna I am still here so then I'm…”

Prema Sarovara is only one place, because Krishna is not the Prema Purushottama. Caitanya Mahaprabhu is — and with him Prema Sarovara is every day, everywhere: eighteen years of crying in pure love of God. — “Chaitanya Mahaprabhu is Prem Purushottam”

🎙 Maharaj at 42:37 (auto-transcript): “But it's only one place but only one place Prem Sarovar is only one place is it not? because Krishna is not Prem Purushottam because Krishna is not Prem Purushottam Chaitanya Mahaprabhu is Prem Purushottam Chaitanya Mahaprabhu is Prem Purushottam Prem Sarovar is everyday…”

Questions on why Mathura rather than Vrindavan was named, on Uddhava's vision, on faith in guru, and on how the Brajavasis can be said to cheat us.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:36 (auto-transcript): “here when Chaitanya Mahaprabhu asked so what's the best form so he answered but then next question when was asked which is the best place he says he did not say it's Vindavan so is there some reason for this So here Chaitanya Vahapru, when you asked Bhagavan in the same way…”

Raghupati Upadhyaya named the best form without hesitation, so why for the best place did he say Mathura rather than Vrindavan? Maharaj answers that Madhupuri here means Mathura-mandala, which is actually Vrindavan.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:36 (auto-transcript): “here when Chaitanya Mahaprabhu asked so what's the best form so he answered but then next question when was asked which is the best place he says he did not say it's Vindavan so is there some reason for this So here Chaitanya Vahapru, when you asked Bhagavan in the same way…”

If the Brajavasis were enjoying, was Uddhava seeing paralysed friends and a dying Yashoda only externally, without the real vision? Maharaj: externally, yes. Krishna sent him ostensibly to console the gopis, but really to upgrade his devotion, which was mixed with jnana.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:44 (auto-transcript): “I have two questions first you said that these Brajavasis they are enjoying themselves fully but cheating us so when Uddhav saw that the friends are paralyzed Mother Yashoda was almost about to die when Krishna left. So is it that Udhav is seeing externally that they are…”

Uddhava tried to preach to Mother Yashoda that Krishna is in every heart, meditate on him. She cut him off: don't talk nonsense here, I am cooking for my son and if he does not eat he will die; go back to your Dwarka. Uddhava, Krishna's trusted counsellor, proud of his knowledge, had never been chastised before.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:08 (auto-transcript): “He wants to give him a prayer, so he came here, and he saw it, when he saw his mother Yashoda and Buddha tried to preach, Krishna is in your hearts, in every place, think of him, think of him, meditation shut up you druska, don't talk nonsense here shut up, shut up”

The gopis took him to a secluded place, away from their elders, and demanded an answer from the learned friend of Krishna. Facing their tears, Uddhava could not say 'do not lament'; he kept quiet. He was learning the lesson he came to learn.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:00 (auto-transcript): “And then when he went to the gopis, The Gopis took him to a secluded place. So Gopi took him to a secluded place. And he sat down. And he sat down. And he said, we'll talk here and open. Our elders are not here. So we won't be shy to express ourselves. So we won't be shy to…”

children.topic: Now I know why Krishna sent me
children.note:
He had never seen anyone cry for Krishna in Dwarka; here he saw complete dedication, everything given up for Krishna. He understood why he was sent, forgot the Yadukumara who sent him, and stayed a long time.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:12 (auto-transcript): “He saw that the people of God were crying. He never cried in Dwarka. But he has seen devotees crying for Krishna. They are called for dedication. A complete dedication. A complete dedication. He gave up everything. He gave up everything. For Krishna. For Krishna. For Krishna.…”

children.topic: Q3 · Faith only for pure devotees?
children.note:
Recalling the earlier story of Narottama Dasa Thakura's disciple who killed an elephant and credited his guru, a devotee asks whether such extreme faith comes only to pure devotees or can grow in practising devotees.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:14 (auto-transcript): “Manoj, some days back, you narrated that the disciples of Narottam Das Thakur, how he caught an elephant and just killed him. And later on, he was asked that, how did you manage to kill such a big elephant? And he said, I didn't do anything, it was my Guru. so here we see…”

Faith starts from wherever we are and keeps rising with our advancement; it does not go down. Love of God is given, not acquired — it comes as we follow sincerely. — “Your love for God is given.”

🎙 Maharaj at 54:33 (auto-transcript): “Faith grows as we are making an assignment. It doesn't go down. It continues to rise. As we rise, our faith becomes stronger. Our faith becomes stronger. Always. Our faith is developed starting from our situation where it starts.”

That disciple had been a feared robber; once he became a devotee the king arrested him and held him for execution. His father paid a powerful tantrik, who entered the cell invisibly and offered a mantra to vanish. The devotee refused: my guru has already given me a mantra, and my only concern is never to forget his lotus feet.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:06 (auto-transcript): “So, this Narottam Das is a good disciple, when he was delivered, and his prophecy, his faith became very strong. He knows, his precious master is with me. When he was doing his robbing and stealing, he was very powerful. The king sends people to arrest him all of them.”

Maharaj dramatises the tantrik's disbelief — people hunt for such a chance and you refuse, you fool — and the disciple's reply that he will chant only Hare Krishna, not a Durga mantra. Because of that faith, his guru was present with him, indeed in him. — “I cannot chant another mantra except what my Guru gives to me.”

🎙 Maharaj at 59:02 (auto-transcript): “People are looking for this opportunity. He got it. He got it. He got it. He got it. He can disappear from here. Can you refuse? You are a fool. I cannot chant another mantra except what my Guru gives to me. I cannot chant another mantra except what my Guru gives to me. Hare…”

The same principle in Caitanya-caritamrta: Rupa Gosvami wrote down the very verse Mahaprabhu was reciting in his mind. When the Lord found the hidden leaf and asked how Rupa could know his mind, Svarupa Damodara said you have given him your mercy. The Lord agreed — anything Rupa Gosvami says is scripture.

children.topic: Q4 · How are they cheating us?
children.note:
A Mataji cannot reconcile the Brajavasis crying with Maharaj's statement that they are cheating us. Maharaj: they are in bliss; we think they are suffering and feel sorry for them, but they are enjoying themselves. That is rasa. — “They are enjoying themselves. That is rasa.”

🎙 Maharaj at 63:27 (auto-transcript): “Unmut, Shaisal? Yes. Just a couple of instances. In today's class you mentioned that Vrajwasi is crying when Krishna is always present in Vrindavan. So you told that they are cheating us. They are just playing with us. And you also told the past time of Prims over. But…”

Beaten through the marketplaces, Haridasa Thakura smiled and told his tormentors to keep beating, he was satisfied. The soldiers could not understand it and feared for their own lives if he did not die, so he entered samadhi to spare them.

🎙 Maharaj at 65:10 (auto-transcript): “When Haridash Thakur was being beaten, What did he do? If you look at the people beating him, You can keep on beating. You can keep on beating. I am satisfied. Why am I satisfied? How is this man smiling with us? How? How do you understand? You can't understand. You can keep…”

The Kazi, thinking burning would purify him, had the body thrown in the Ganga. Haridasa later told Mahaprabhu what happened and heard: I came with the Sudarshan cakra to kill them, but you were not happy, so I covered you with my own body. He walked back unharmed to the astonished Kazi.

🎙 Maharaj at 67:04 (auto-transcript): “Kazi was thinking that he is very intelligent. No, no. If we burn him, he will get purified. He is very faithful. He is very faithful. So, what will he do? No. He will not do it. He does not know Chitana Mahapur is tricking him. He doesn't know Chitana Mahapur is tricking…”

Maharaj's closing lesson: these pastimes teach us that whatever happens to us, we should not leave Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 70:01 (auto-transcript): “The purpose of this person. This little girl is the reason. That whatever happened to us, we should not leave Krishna consciousness. Oh, glorious assembly.”

maps.title: Rupa Siksa · Day 12 · Effect of Seeing Lord Chaitanya

nodeData.topic: Day 12 · Effect of Seeing Lord Chaitanya
nodeData.note: CC Madhya 19.103–114 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Raghupati Upadhyaya answers Mahaprabhu's questions — conjugal love is the best rasa and Krishna's fresh youth the best age — and is embraced by the Lord. Vallabha Bhatta brings his sons to the Lord's feet, the people of Prayaga become devotees simply by seeing Him, and Vallabha Bhatta takes Him to Adaila. Maharaj dwells on how the Lord sees what has not yet happened, and in the Q&A on why we do not feel the Lord's blessings and how Gundica-marjana maps our gross and subtle anarthas. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Mahaprabhu asks Raghupati Upadhyaya which of all the rasas is best and which of Krishna's ages is best; Raghupati answers madhurya-rasa and the fresh youth of Krishna.

Maharaj quizzes the room: from one to five is called what? Balya. Then? Pauganda, up to ten. And eleven to fifteen? Kaisora. He wants the audience to say the words themselves.

🎙 Maharaj at 07:05 (auto-transcript): “I see you. From one to five, What is it called? Here it is Ballya. Do you know what Ballya has? Pau Ganda. Kishorena. 5, 5, 6, 6 to 10. Pau Ganda. 11 to 15. Kishorena.”

children.topic: Kaisora, the age of conjugal play
children.note:
Raghupati Upadhyaya names kaisora, Krishna's fresh youth, as the best, because it is the age in which Krishna enjoyed most — the conjugal pastimes with the gopis belong to this period.

🎙 Maharaj at 07:51 (auto-transcript): “Who is the best? Gupati Upadhyaya said, Kaisura came, Kaisura fresh with the best. It was this age who has enjoyed the most. Who has enjoyed it? Better not be sure. Full.”

Maharaj notes that Mahaprabhu keeps asking questions. It is not that He is being taught by Raghupati Upadhyaya; He asks so that the right conclusion is spoken aloud in front of everyone.

🎙 Maharaj at 08:56 (auto-transcript): “This is an always asking question. And the Jewish is devoted to speak. This is not teaching Dhanuti. It is. This is why he is asking the question. Shri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu said,”
Mahaprabhu tells Raghupati Upadhyaya he has given the right conclusions, and Raghupati recites verses of his own; the Lord embraces him in ecstatic love and he begins to dance.

Maharaj dwells on the picture: a learned scholar, held in the Lord's embrace, forgets his dignity and dances in love. This is the effect of the Lord's touch.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:50 (auto-transcript): “in aesthetic love. Raghupati Upadhyaya was so aware and loved and began to dance. Shri Vajabha Pradhamane Thilmatyakara Aayapara Vigiput Tratnane Prabhupada Charyapadhyaya Anuvat, Shri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu Tathha Raghupati Upadhyayako naaste dekhkar Valabha Charya, Aash Ch…”
Seeing the Lord and Raghupati Upadhyaya dancing, Vallabha Bhattacarya is struck with wonder and makes his two sons fall at the Lord's feet.

From the purport Maharaj takes up a difficulty: the two sons were Gopinatha and Vitthalesvara, yet by the dates given Vitthalesvara was not yet born when Mahaprabhu visited Prayaga. He works out the years with the audience.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:52 (auto-transcript): “We had to see Madhya Gila in 1947. Valapar Bhattacharya was stopped with wonder to see Sitchlin Mahaprabhu and Raghupayki Upadhyaya times. He even brought forward his two sons, and made them fall down, and they lost the prestige. The two sons of Bhagavad Gita Chaya were…”

The purport recalls how, out of fear of the Muslims, Gopala went to Mathura and stayed a month in the house of Vitthalesvara, and how Rupa Gosvami saw Gopala there to his heart's content, as told in Madhya-lila 18.

Maharaj puts the problem squarely: the verse says two sons, but Vitthalesvara was born only about two years after the Lord's visit. He asks the room — do you see what I am saying? — and some agree it must have been one son.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:30 (auto-transcript): “Do you think I say this? We are saying that Valdavacharya brought two of this son. Yes. And then Mithalaj Mithalaj was not even born. So only one son. That's the date of Paris then. 15, 37 years he was born. So Chathamakur visited on 14, or 14, 35 years. After 2 years, he…”

children.topic: The Lord sees what is not yet born
children.note:
Maharaj's resolution: Mahaprabhu does not need to see a child physically. He sees the whole future of the child, so there is no contradiction in His accepting the son who was still to come.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:28 (auto-transcript): “Shri Tita Mahakrabhu, there is no need to see the child physically. You could see the child's whole saccadence. In the same way, Shri Tita Mahakrabhu will introduce Shriva Sarchariya. He introduced them to Rupa Sanatana, Maragaswamis, and He told them, Seva Sachara is coming…”

In the same way Mahaprabhu told Rupa and Sanatana Gosvamis that Srinivasa Acarya would come and join them and that they should train him properly, though Srinivasa had not yet appeared. The Gosvamis were ready for him when he came.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:47 (auto-transcript): “In the same way, Shri Tita Mahakrabhu will introduce Shriva Sarchariya. He introduced them to Rupa Sanatana, Maragaswamis, and He told them, Seva Sachara is coming and join them each. They should train Him properly. He made the books. He should train them. In that process,…”

Mahaprabhu once called out Narottam, Narottam, and everyone around asked, who is Narottam? Nobody knew him, because Narottama dasa Thakura had not been born. The Lord already saw him. So too Vallabha Bhatta's children: not yet born, yet for the Lord already born.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:24 (auto-transcript): “What did he say about Narottam? He called him Narottam, Narottam. Who is Narottam here? Shaitanya Mahaprabhu called Narottam, Narottam. And everyone asked him, who is Narottam? Who is Narottam? Who is Narottam? Who is Narottam? I didn't know anyone, but Chaitanya Mahaprabhu…”
Hearing that Mahaprabhu has come, all the brahmanas of the place come for His darshan, and simply by seeing Him they become devotees of Krishna.

Maharaj compares the Lord's presence to the Yamuna: just by seeing the river one is purified, without touching or bathing. Being in the Lord's presence does the same.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:26 (auto-transcript): “But being in presence, one can feel the same thing he said in Jamuna. Just by seeing Jamuna, one can feel right. Not only dating them. by seeing all the people. Naimisharanya. Just hearing Naimisharanya,”

The scriptures say that merely hearing the name Naimisaranya removes a large portion of one's karma, and setting foot there does far more. If a holy place has such potency, what to speak of seeing the Lord of all holy places. — “50% of our karma is missed.”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:08 (auto-transcript): “Naimisharanya. Just hearing Naimisharanya, 50% of our karma is missed. Naimisharanya, 50% of our karma is missed. This is the scripture. And if you make mistake to step their feet there,”

The people of Prayaga were transformed just by looking. Some of them did not even come to hear the Lord speak; they saw Him, and that was enough.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:50 (auto-transcript): “When people see Chakramakurubh, after seeing him, all of them were created. Some of them didn't even come to hear him. They saw the Lord. and some people have been able to teach them.”

children.topic: 19.110–112 — Vallabha Bhatta takes the Lord to Adaila
children.note: The brahmanas of Prayaga all want to invite the Lord for lunch, but Vallabha Bhattacarya forbids them and decides to take the Lord to his own village, Adaila, announcing that whoever wishes may come there to see Him.

Maharaj notes the eagerness of the local brahmanas — each one wanted the Lord in his house — and that Vallabha Bhatta used his standing to keep that privilege for himself.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:01 (auto-transcript): “Over the Brahmanas of the village, we have eager Christian limitations to the Lord. But other potentials have forbidden to go show. Adipati Niswad, Nishwaki Chaitanya Mahaprabhu”

children.topic: Because He jumped in the Yamuna
children.note:
Vallabha Bhatta's reason for not keeping the Lord at Prayaga: the Lord had thrown Himself into the Yamuna in ecstasy, and Vallabha Bhatta was anxious for His safety. So he brought Him to Adaila on the other bank.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:49 (auto-transcript): “Mali-va-kwata then decided not to keep the children from the highlands because the Lord had jumped into the Ego-jumit in a Celtic Lord. Therefore, He decided to bring Him to Kaya. Ms. Anwar, Ghalab Bhatt née kaha, Jiski Ichha ho, Wa prayaab ja saktâ hai,”

Vallabha Bhatta did not shut the Lord away; he told the people that anyone who wanted to see Him could come to Adaila, and so the Lord departed with him.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:10 (auto-transcript): “Ms. Anwar, Ghalab Bhatt née kaha, Jiski Ichha ho, Wa prayaab ja saktâ hai, With anyone who thinks, they can go through prayer and extend temptations.”

Two questions: why we do not feel the blessings the scriptures promise, and how the sequence of cleaning the Gundica temple relates to cleaning our anarthas.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:09 (auto-transcript): “So, we have had so many blessings. For example, you have explained how just by seeing Yamuna, it becomes terrified. And we have also seen that by eating the remnants of the salvage, it is said that all his sins were purified. So is it safe to assume that we are not getting…”

children.topic: Q1 · Are offences blocking the blessings?
children.note:
Seeing the Yamuna purifies, eating the Lord's remnants destroys sins — so if I am still suffering, is it safe to assume that offences are stopping the full result? Maharaj answers that the result is there; the question is our fitness to receive it.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:34 (auto-transcript): “For example, you have explained how just by seeing Yamuna, it becomes terrified. And we have also seen that by eating the remnants of the salvage, it is said that all his sins were purified. So is it safe to assume that we are not getting the full result of all of these…”

Maharaj says we are waiting for our own experience, but experience follows fitness. We are doing so much and yet not getting the full result because we are not yet fit, and that unfitness is why we are still here.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:26 (auto-transcript): “We are waiting for our experience. What? Fitless. Fitless. If we are fit, we are not fit. It is not a problem.”

The people of Prayaga saw the Lord directly. We are not like them, but we are given eyes through the Bhagavatam and the devotees; the trouble is that we are afraid to look.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:19 (auto-transcript): “Because we will see in the Lord directly. We are giving him eyes from the Bhagavan. We are just scared to see. We are just scared to see. They didn't know that, but it was strong. They didn't know that they were supposed to be a good thing. Chaitanya Mahmuram has given them…”

How will someone who cannot see describe a colour? By hearing about it. Maharaj says that in our condition the Lord's form and beauty come to us by hearing, and from hearing the seeing follows.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:43 (auto-transcript): “He is saying by hearing about it. By hearing and by beauty, call on.”

From a recent lecture: Mahaprabhu cleaned the Gundica temple ceiling first, then fans, then walls, then floor. Does that order say anything about how our anarthas are cleaned? Maharaj says yes, and goes through it.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:53 (auto-transcript): “In your recent Gunti Chamarjan lecture, I have two questions from there. You described that Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu started cleaning the temple from the ceiling, then fan, then walls and then ground. So is there any relation, and you also mentioned that this Gundicha Marjan…”

Ceiling, fans, walls and floor are all the outside. First the gross, visible dirt is removed; only after that can the source inside be reached. Some things come with us into bhakti and are dealt with later.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:16 (auto-transcript): “These are all outside. After the outside, then the source. After the source, the source. We were told that there are some things that come with us. When we are”

Maharaj names the suksma-anarthas we grow inside devotional life: once I am a devotee I will become guru, GBC, sannyasi, president, project director, councillor. He teases the room — I have five preaching centres, how many do you have? This ego and desire for prestige is the fine dust Mahaprabhu was sweeping. — “If I become a devotee, I will become a guru”

🎙 Maharaj at 43:33 (auto-transcript): “If I become a devotee, I will become a guru I became a GBC, I became a Sanya, I became a President, I became a Project Director, I became a Councilor. Anyone want to think about this? We didn't know this. We are all trying to do this. When we clean the Anarth that we brought…”

After sweeping, the temple was washed with water — and Mahaprabhu washed it with His tears as well. Maharaj says our cleaning must also reach that stage; sweeping alone is not finished work.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:13 (auto-transcript): “And we were washing with the water and washing with the tears. And Chakra Mahaprabhu was washing with the water and washing with the tears. We had to do that. There is no guidance. There is no guidance. and always have the plant when the plant is a plant many small plants…”

When the bhakti plant comes up, many small plants rise beside it and can outgrow it. Maharaj gives an example: chanting while half asleep, two hours pass and five rounds are done, and we think our japa is going wonderfully. The gardener must be careful which tree is growing. — “There are many unwanted trees.”

🎙 Maharaj at 47:40 (auto-transcript): “and always have the plant when the plant is a plant many small plants will rise they will be better than the plant you know when you are sleeping and chanting you know how you feel I will jump This is what?”

Mahaprabhu had the dirty water carried far from the temple so it would not flow back in. Likewise what we gave up before coming to bhakti should be kept far, not brought back. Maharaj cites Gita 2.49–50: keep abominable work at a distance by devotional service; those who want to enjoy the fruits of their work are misers.

maps.title: Rupa Siksa · Day 13 · We Should Be Feeling Left Out

nodeData.topic: Day 13 · We Should Be Feeling Left Out
nodeData.note: CC Madhya 19.115–128 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Mahaprabhu enters Rupa Gosvami's heart and empowers him with every conclusion — not book knowledge but personal training, like tuning a radio to the Lord's station. Prema is given, not acquired, so we must go and beg it from those who have it, and if we do not feel left out we are very far. Rupa Gosvami is Mahaprabhu's own replica, so rain, heat and cold could not touch the brothers under the trees of Vrindavan; and devotees should gather to hear of such Vaishnavas, not to gossip. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: These verses describe Mahaprabhu teaching Rupa Gosvami the full truth of Krishna, devotional service and rasa, and entering his heart to empower him to settle every conclusion in line with the disciplic succession.

Maharaj stresses that Mahaprabhu did not hand Rupa Gosvami a theory; he personally showed him what devotional service is and trained him. This cannot be read from a book — someone has to train us. — “This is the meaning of empowerment.”

🎙 Maharaj at 10:50 (auto-transcript): “Not a theoretical knowledge. He personally showed him what is devotional service. This is the meaning of empowerment. He even trained. Right? To understand You cannot read this from the book.”

Maharaj's example: Mahaprabhu told the boy Puri Das simply to recite, without saying what. The boy at once spoke a verse that was in Mahaprabhu's own heart — one who has been trained and blessed automatically knows what the Lord feels and thinks.

🎙 Maharaj at 11:46 (auto-transcript): “For example, when Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu told Puri Das, recite, He didn't tell him what to recite. We will order Him beside him. We will order Him beside him. Immediately, Puri Das is set in a mantra which is in Chaitanya Mahabhubhub's heart. Because like Rupa Goswami”

Like a radio at home: tune to the station and whatever is transmitted reaches you. Those who have no set, or have not tuned in, receive nothing. Rupa Gosvami was tuned to Mahaprabhu.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:15 (auto-transcript): “if you have a radio in your house and you turn to the station whatever is there is transmitted to those who have a station Those who don't have the station or they have not turned to that station you get a message Whatever he transmitted there Those who are listening”

children.topic: Fed with pure love of God
children.note:
Maharaj asks the room what was in Mahaprabhu's toe when he placed it in the baby's mouth. The answer: pure love of God. The child drank it like a baby drinks milk, to full satisfaction — and Rupa Gosvami's heart was filled the same way.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:04 (auto-transcript): “So Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu and put his toe what is there the toe what is there what is there the toe particularly particularly particularly what is there what is there are the two of Chita Mahaprabhu”

children.topic: We should be feeling left out
children.note:
Maharaj turns the verse on the audience: hearing how Mahaprabhu feeds his devotees, we should feel we are missing it. If we do not feel left out, we are very far away; those who are near immediately feel the loss of such an opportunity.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:01 (auto-transcript): “we miss it we miss it you are not feeling miss out you are not feeling miss out if you are not feeling miss out we are very far those are very near immediately upon hearing this they will think that we will not be able to and they will feel that we will not be able to have…”

Maharaj asks how Mahaprabhu entered Narayani — through prasadam — and what the result was: Vrindavan Das Thakura, whom he calls maha-prasadam personified.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:48 (auto-transcript): “Shri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu entered Narayani How did he enter? What is the result of entering? Prashad. He entered through? Prashad. By Prashadam. What is the result of that Prashad? Narayani ke irde mein Bhagawan Prashad ke rup mein nikkle. Or kya uska pratifal nikkla? What is…”

No one in this world is better than Rupa and Sanatana Gosvamis, yet Mahaprabhu still asks Advaita Acarya to give them prema. They already have it; the request is made to teach us the process.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:27 (auto-transcript): “Maha Prashad. Prem is given He is not acquired It is given Shri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu Advaita Acharya You will never find Anybody in this world Better than Rupa Sanatana Goswami You will never find anyone better than them But see, give them prema.”

children.topic: Go and beg from one who has it
children.note:
Since prema is given by Mahaprabhu to his pure devotees, our only course is to go to them, pray and beg. Maharaj repeats the word again and again. — “We have to beg”

🎙 Maharaj at 18:52 (auto-transcript): “To teach us the process, Shri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu is requesting Advatacharya Gildama. we have to from someone who has it. Chaitanya Mahaprabhu is giving to his pure devotees. Therefore, we have to go to him and pray to them. We have to beg to beg to beg to beg to beg to beg…”

Devotional service only appears to be under material jurisdiction; material energy has no influence on Krishna-prema at all. So we must be personally guided by Mahaprabhu and his representative — that is what is happening here.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:05 (auto-transcript): “Material energy has no influence on Krishna Parma. Zero. Zero. Zero. Food independent. Greatly guided. Greatly guided. Personally guided by Shri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu and his representative. So we have to go to someone who has it.”

These verses note that Kavi Karnapura, son of Sivananda Sena, described this meeting in his Caitanya-candrodaya, and that Mahaprabhu empowered the two brothers to recover the Vrindavan pastimes that were almost lost.

Kavi Karnapura's verses: Rupa Gosvami, attracted from the start, was freed from family life, and as the embodiment of Mahaprabhu's ecstatic love he was fit to explain Krishna and write transcendental literature.

Maharaj asks what 'replica' means and gives the Hindi anukriti: Rupa Gosvami is the second body, the expansion of Mahaprabhu, and for that reason very, very dear to the Lord.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:49 (auto-transcript): “Replica. Anukriti. What does that mean? Replica. What is it? Replica means? Anukriti. Anukriti. It's a complete man. This is the second body of Chita Mahaprabhu. The second body is Shri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu. It's the expansion of Chita Mahaprabhu. Shri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu's…”

Naturally beautiful outside, beautiful inside, beautiful in his words — everything about Rupa Gosvami is beautiful, because he carefully followed what the Lord gave him.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:45 (auto-transcript): “Shri Rupaswami was naturally very beautiful outside beautiful inside beautiful inside beautiful both is beautiful his world is beautiful everything about him is beautiful He was very carefully followed the principles initiated by the Lord. He was a competent person to explain…”

Rupa Gosvami has the measurement of Krishna's whole body — head, fish-like eyes, nose, lips, hands, joints, neck — like a tailor who measures before making a shirt. Mahaprabhu equipped him with everything his service needed; there is no speculation. — “He has a measure for Krishna's complete body.”

🎙 Maharaj at 29:43 (auto-transcript): “Shri Laroop Goswami has a perfect measure of an entire Krishna's body. Rupa Goswami knows the size of Krishna's head. Shri Laroop Goswami can you imagine? Rupa Goswami can measure Krishna's head. Shri Laroop Goswami Bhagawan Krishna's head can map Krishna's eyes like a fish…”

Whatever Rupa Gosvami said is scripture. He even detailed the varieties of laughter. When we know our scripture we can see everything completely. — “Anything Rupa Goswami said is a scripture”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:35 (auto-transcript): “Anything Rupa Goswami said is a scripture Anything Even if he cocks It's a scripture It's a scripture Right And Rupa Goswami He gave different varieties of laughing What are it is? So indeed Eyes”
Rupa Gosvami's qualities are described in many places by Kavi Karnapura; Mahaprabhu gave his causeless mercy to both brothers, who became objects of love and honour for all the Lord's devotees.

Whenever someone returned from Vrindavan, Mahaprabhu would ask after the brothers — their activities, how they eat — and would hear how they lived under trees, begged a little, and took only dry bread and chickpeas.

They never spent two nights under the same tree, and they did not sleep together — Sanatana under this tree, Rupa under that. During the day they came together to discuss Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:01 (auto-transcript): “Rupa Goswami and Sanathana Goswami, they never sleep under a tree for two days. One night only. One night only. One tree, one night. They didn't sleep together. They didn't sleep together. They didn't sleep together. Sanatan Goswami, this tree, Rupa Goswami, that tree.…”

Maharaj asks how they protected ink manuscripts through the monsoon with no house, no kitchen, only trees. Answers from the floor — there was no rain, they kept them in the temple — he sets aside: there was no temple then. — “The temple came afterwards for us, not for them.”

🎙 Maharaj at 41:03 (auto-transcript): “How do they preserve their writing in the rain? They were writing with ink. They were writing with ink. They were not writing with ink. The water touches ink. The water will burst with ink. Everything is finished. How were they preserving their writings? How were they…”

His answer comes from Govardhan: Indra's devastation could not touch Krishna. If Rupa Gosvami is Mahaprabhu's duplicate, how can water touch him? Rain, cold and heat never touched the brothers, and their writings were perfectly protected.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:56 (auto-transcript): “He explains, when Indra was sending rain, not rain, devastation, the water devastation. So Krishna lived here and walks to the mountain. and went to Gowardhan but he did not touch it so if Rugga Swami if he is a duplicate of Shri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu”

Mahaprabhu expanded himself as Rupa Gosvami and as Srinivasa Acarya. Maharaj warns not to confuse Srinivasa with Srivasa Thakura, who is Narada Muni.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:12 (auto-transcript): “Shri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu expanded himself. Shri Rupa Goswami. Shri Vasacharya. Shri Nivas. Sri Nivas Acharya. They are two people. Sri Vaas is different. Sri Vaas is different. Sri Vaas is Narad Muni. Sri Vaas Ji Narad Muni is. Sri Vaas is Chetan Mahabhru. Sri Vaas is Shri…”

When Krishna was present everything was spring. Maharaj lists India's six seasons against the West's four, and says excessive heat and cold are punishments for our sins — which is why the sinless brothers felt no such torture.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:10 (auto-transcript): “Just like when Krishna was physically present everything was spring. So sabhi kuch basant tha. The summer, the winter, thandi, autumn, Sarad Dew season Dew Oshka Mahina We are used to a four We are only four from 4 We are only four from 4 That's why you have many people We…”

Former ministers now in kaupinas — the sacrifice is enormous, and Krishna provides. Going to brahmanas' houses was not really begging; they went only to bless the households they visited. — “They had gone only to give blessing”

🎙 Maharaj at 49:18 (auto-transcript): “See, the ministers. These ministers. minister and now kaupin viera you see this sacrifice is too much sacrifice is too much how Krishna wanna protect them how Krishna wanna provide how Krishna wanna provide going to beg In the house of the Brahman It is just a pretense They…”

When devotees returned from Vrindavan all the Vaishnavas gathered to hear how Rupa and Sanatana were living as renunciants. Maharaj presents this as the principle for devotees.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:50 (auto-transcript): “so when devotions return from Brindavan All other Vaishnamas, they come together. To hear. To know. What are the activities of Rupa Goswami and Sanatana Goswami? How are they living as annunciates? Some annunciates. Some annunciates are just bogh.”

Some renunciants are bogus, but everybody loved these two because of their purity and their magnanimous nature — so everyone wanted to hear about them.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:08 (auto-transcript): “What are the activities of Rupa Goswami and Sanatana Goswami? How are they living as annunciates? Some annunciates. Some annunciates are just bogh. Everybody loves them, everybody loves them, everybody loves them, because of their purity. They are a magnanimous nature, they…”

When a devotee came back from seeing Prabhupada, the whole temple gathered: what is the report, what is the message? Hearing it they felt empowered and went out to act. Maharaj says this is how ISKCON expanded.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:15 (auto-transcript): “The disciples of Prabhupada also did the same thing. When Prabhupada came to see Prabhupada, when he returned to his temple, when he returned to his temple, all the devotees went there. What is the report from Prabhupada? What is the message from Prabhupada? What is the…”

Today coming together means gossip — who is this, who is that. We are not following the principle, and Maharaj says we have to change it.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:51 (auto-transcript): “This is not the principle we are following today. Today he is Gashi. That's all. So we cannot be the same. Gossip room will come today. People come together is gossiping. We don't have to do it. We are coming together together. Who is this? That's the time. Who is this?…”

children.topic: Hear pure devotees, get their qualities
children.note:
We should meet to speak and hear about Krishna and his pure devotees. Hear pure devotees with a good heart and their qualities come to us; hear faults and we cannot become good. — “We should come together to listen to Krishna's pure words.”

🎙 Maharaj at 54:22 (auto-transcript): “We should not change it. We should meet together to talk about Krishna. Hear about Krishna. Krishna's pure words. We should come together to listen to Krishna's pure words. Krishna's pure words and pure words. If you hear about pure words, with good heart, you will get their…”

children.topic: What did you do in Vrindavan?
children.note:
Maharaj models the right report: we met wonderful devotees, heard of their preaching, and now we also want to do something. This, he says, is Krishna-bhavanamrita.

🎙 Maharaj at 55:32 (auto-transcript): “What message? What did you do in Vrindavan? What did you do? Where did you go? Here. Tell me what you want to do. Yes, we met with wonderful devotees. Yes, we met with wonderful devotees. Hearing their activities. And hearing their preaching activities. And hearing their…”

maps.title: Rupa Siksa · Day 14 · Krishna's Quilt Stolen

nodeData.note: CC Madhya 19.129 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. The Gosvamis' life under the trees with dry bread and chickpeas was not austerity for them but normal life — real renunciation is having everything and not being attracted. The verse's quilts lead Maharaj to the story of Krishna's blanket stolen by the gopis and given to Durvasa Muni: one gives service to a sadhu and takes only knowledge. A long Q&A on whether prema is a feeling or a substance, the fear of losing one's life in Krishna consciousness, servant versus gopi-bhava, and how everyone can serve a sadhu. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Maharaj picks up Madhya-lila 19 where the class stopped the day before: the renunciation of Rupa Gosvami and Sanatana Gosvami after Mahaprabhu's instructions. He asks the room what that renunciation actually was.

Maharaj lists what the brothers gave up: no fixed residence, a different tree each night, a little food begged from brahmana homes, and no material enjoyment at all.

🎙 Maharaj at 03:15 (auto-transcript): “What was the renunciation? They have no fixed residence. They reside in mini trees. One night, another one tree. The next night, another tree. They bake little food from the houses of Brahmana. Giving up all kinds of material enjoyment.”

Their food was dry bread and fried chickpeas — no spices, no ghee, no salt, no sabji. Maharaj spells out each missing item so the room feels how plain it was.

🎙 Maharaj at 03:50 (auto-transcript): “They bake little food from the houses of Brahmana. Giving up all kinds of material enjoyment. They take only some dry bread. And fried chickpeas. Dried bread. Not cooked with this. Spices.”

Maharaj asks whether this was austerity for Rupa and Sanatana and answers no: for them it was simply normal life. He reminds everyone that these two had lived for years in the opposite situation, in great opulence. — “This is not austerity. This is normal life.”

🎙 Maharaj at 04:49 (auto-transcript): “Is it austerity for Sanatana Rupa Goswami? No. This is not austerity. This is normal life. Don't forget. These two devotees, they have lived in an opponent situation for years. These people have been living in a very serious city for years and years. How many people have been…”

How many have visited the place in Bengal where Sanatana Gosvami was imprisoned? Maharaj says it is no jail — it is a mansion that even a bulldozer could hardly break. Jail only in Krishna's sense. Yet the brothers threw that life away like trash and ate dried chickpeas happily, without complaint. — “It is a palace.”

🎙 Maharaj at 05:32 (auto-transcript): “How many people have been to Sanadan Goswami's jail? How many people have been to Sanadan Goswami's jail? Where is Bengal? Three. Three. Is that the jail? Is it the jail? Is it the jail? It's a mansion. It was a mansion. Today, the bulldozer cannot break it. A bulldozer can…”

Maharaj defines pure renunciation: you have everything, you are rich, and you are not attracted to it. For a poor person giving things up is easy because there was never another life anyway. — “It is not austerity but starvation.”

🎙 Maharaj at 07:40 (auto-transcript): “This is renunciation. When you have everything. We are rich. And you are not attracted to it. That is pure renunciation. Otherwise. It is not austerity but starvation. Starvation. Different from austerity. Starvation, there is nothing there. Second or otherwise, nothing.”

In starvation there is simply nothing there. In austerity everything is available and still one is not attracted to anything. This, Maharaj says, is what the Gosvamis teach us.

🎙 Maharaj at 08:16 (auto-transcript): “Starvation. Different from austerity. Starvation, there is nothing there. Second or otherwise, nothing. Austerity, you have everything. Yet, you are not attracted to anything. This is what the Goswami are teaching us. They carry only water pots. And they wear only quilts.…”
The verse describes the Gosvamis carrying only water pots and wearing torn quilts, always chanting Krishna's names, discussing his pastimes and dancing in jubilation.

Maharaj explains the word quilt — a blanket, gudri in Hindi — and notes that the same morning another visiting Maharaj had spoken about Krishna's blanket, which makes a nice connection to today's verse.

🎙 Maharaj at 10:07 (auto-transcript): “This morning we are hearing, quilt is what? Blanket. Blanket. So this is Goswami's kriya. Quilt means gudri. His Holiness in the Deomana Maharaj was discussed by what? Blanket. So Param Pooja Indra Divna Swami Maharaj is Gudri ke baare me charcha kar rahe the very nice…”

Krishna's blanket was stolen by the gopis. Maharaj sets up the puzzle with the Gita's line that the Lord's eyes, heads and faces are everywhere — so how could anyone steal from him?

🎙 Maharaj at 10:38 (auto-transcript): “Krishna's blanket was stolen by the gopis Krishna ke chadar ko gopi loge ne chudha liya tha yeah philosophy say aam loge kishe dhant kehata hai Sarvato Akshi Shira Mukham Sarvato Akshi Shira Mukham Everywhere, Krishna's, everywhere, Krishna's eyes.”

Krishna's eyes are everywhere, and still his blanket was taken. Why did he let his devotees do it? For their pleasure — he likes his things to be stolen by them. Maharaj asks the room: do you want the blanket to be stolen?

🎙 Maharaj at 11:16 (auto-transcript): “Everywhere, Krishna's, everywhere, Krishna's eyes. But his blanket was stolen. Eyes, eyes everywhere. Tell me. His eyes everywhere. Why did he see he stole his blanket? How did he destroy his devotee? For the pleasure of his devotees.”

children.topic: The cheat of cheats gets cheated
children.note:
Krishna declares in the Gita that he is the gambling of cheats, yet here he himself is cheated. That is Krishna — he enjoys being outwitted. — “He wants, he likes to be cheated.”

🎙 Maharaj at 12:42 (auto-transcript): “The Supreme Lord? Who said, I am, I am, the gamble, the cheat. Krishna says, I am, I am, I am, I am, I am, Krishna is, what? The gambler of the cheats. Yet. He was gambled.”

Who may cheat Krishna? Not Kamsa, not Pralambasura. Only devotees can deal with Krishna like this.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:39 (auto-transcript): “By Kamsa? Pralambasura. By who? devotees devotees yes only devotees can deal with Krishna like this blankets past time past time there is a a forest a forest when this past time was performed you mean there?”

children.topic: We will go to that forest
children.note:
The pastime happened in a forest nearby. When the audience says they want to go, Maharaj promises to arrange a visit — the whole pastime can be narrated there, even enacted as a drama, so that it becomes our meditation.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:09 (auto-transcript): “there is a a forest a forest when this past time was performed you mean there? you mean there? what's the name of the place? we'll go there you want to go there? we'll go there we'll have the full past time we'll go there So, Krishna's blanket was stolen.”

children.topic: The blanket goes to Durvasa Muni
children.note:
The gopis gave the stolen blanket to Durvasa Muni. Krishna woke, demanded his blanket, accused the gopis, and searched until he found it with the sage.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:49 (auto-transcript): “So, Krishna's blanket was stolen. And it was given to Durvasamuni. So, Krishna woke up. Where's my blanket? Where's my blanket? Oh, you gopi stole it. No. No, we didn't steal it. So Krishna started searching. They were searching. And they finally saw it with Durvasamuni.”

children.topic: It was mine; now it is yours
children.note:
When Durvasa asked whether he was looking for his blanket, Krishna replied that it had been his but was no longer: he does not take anything from sadhus. Now that the sage had it, it was his. — “I don't take anything from sadhus”

🎙 Maharaj at 15:52 (auto-transcript): “Krishna said, it was my blanket now it is not my blanket I don't take anything from sadhus so now that you have the blanket it is yours the only thing that you should take from sadhu is So, I have given you a blanket, therefore, he should give me knowledge, how to understand”

children.topic: Take only knowledge from a sadhu
children.note:
The one thing to take from a sadhu is knowledge. Krishna reasons that since he has given the blanket, Durvasa should give him knowledge in return — how to understand and serve Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:16 (auto-transcript): “the only thing that you should take from sadhu is So, I have given you a blanket, therefore, he should give me knowledge, how to understand Krishna, Krishna wants to understand how to serve Krishna, Krishna wants to understand I want to go to the forest.”

Five questions from the floor: how prema can be given, why Krishna sought knowledge from Durvasa, the fear of losing one's life, servant versus gopi, and how to serve a sadhu.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:30 (auto-transcript): “Okay, comments or questions? Yes, brother. Shri Gurudev, thank you very much. Shri Gurudev, yesterday when you were saying how Chaitanya Mahaprabhu had instructed Advaita Acharya to give them Prema so I was thinking like how this works because it's not it's not an object…”

Yesterday Mahaprabhu told Advaita Acarya to give the brothers prema and he simply agreed. Prema is not an object — so how does such a transfer work? Maharaj turns it back: when we say Krishna-prema, what do we actually know about it?

🎙 Maharaj at 17:47 (auto-transcript): “Shri Gurudev, thank you very much. Shri Gurudev, yesterday when you were saying how Chaitanya Mahaprabhu had instructed Advaita Acharya to give them Prema so I was thinking like how this works because it's not it's not an object Prema Prema is not like some object that you…”

The room offers answers — a feeling, an attitude, a desire to serve all the time. Maharaj keeps pressing: is it a feeling or a thing?

🎙 Maharaj at 20:06 (auto-transcript): “What is it? What is it? Is it an object? I would break your head and... What is it? It's a feeling. Don't look at me and don't look at you. Prema? Like that? Okay. Attitude. Attitude. The separation. What? What are we the separation?”

children.topic: Kept in the Padma for Narottama
children.note:
Mahaprabhu kept Krishna-prema in the river Padma, waiting for Narottama dasa Thakura. Maharaj asks: can you keep a feeling somewhere? Padma Devi asked Narottama where he would keep it.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:46 (auto-transcript): “Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu. Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu. Kept Krishna Prema. Krishna Prema ko rakhe. In Padma Riva. Padma Nadi me. So is it a feeling? To kya ye bhao hai? Object. Kya ye vasutu hai? Something you are keeping. What is it? Agar kis chiz ko rakhte hai. Kya hai ho?…”

Narottama said nothing; he received it and drank it. So prema is vastu — a substance, a reality, not something vague. After drinking he was transformed inside and out; his own mother walked past without recognising him until he called to her.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:12 (auto-transcript): “This object. So Krishna Prem is Vastu. So Nartam Daszakura He's drunk it. What is that? Is it object or not? Is it feeling or object? Something, something here. Yes. Not just a feeling. Something that you feel. Example, if you have a sensation. If you have a sensation. Is it…”

Krishna-prema is something that can be given and was given. That is the process: it is not won by our own strength but granted by those who have it. — “Not acquired by your strength.”

🎙 Maharaj at 26:46 (auto-transcript): “So when we say Krishna Prem, It's a person. That can be given. And was given. That is the process. It's given. Not acquired by your strength. It's given. By those who have it. So, we have been discussing that Brahma-muhurta period is a fatal period, fatal period. We have our…”

Maharaj links this to the early-morning brahma-muhurta practice discussed on earlier days. Krishna and his name are there 24 hours, but the reciprocation depends on our input — the same practice yields different advancement according to what we bring. So no grumbling about being woken early. — “You should not be grudging.”

🎙 Maharaj at 27:16 (auto-transcript): “So, we have been discussing that Brahma-muhurta period is a fatal period, fatal period. We have our bhakti can be consciously practiced, and that should be facilitated with the good mood. And our Krishna consistently becomes a reality faster. Even though Krishna is there 24…”

children.topic: Q2 · Why does all-knowing Krishna seek knowledge?
children.note:
If Krishna is sarvajna, why ask Durvasa Muni for knowledge, and what could the sage give him? Maharaj calls it a very good question.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:24 (auto-transcript): “I have a question that as we know that Krishna is all knowledgeable, he knows everything, then why is he seeking knowledge from Duruvasa Muni and what knowledge did he give to Krishna? Very good. When we know that Bhagavan is a Sarvagyaya, then why do we need Duruvasa Muni…”

Maharaj recalls Krishna's own words in the Gita — he is knowledge, he compiled the Vedas, he knows them and is the one to be known. So Krishna needs nothing from Durvasa.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:58 (auto-transcript): “Krishna is all Krishna Sarvajya Bargita Krishna said He is Gnana Krishna says in Gita I am Gnana Gyeh Gnana Gnana That is chapter 18 In 1515 He also repeated I compiled the vedas I have made the Vedas to know me, I know the Vedas, and I am to be known.”

children.topic: Acting as a Vrajavasi, teaching us
children.note:
Here Krishna is not acting as the Supreme God but as an ordinary resident of Vraja, representing us and showing what we should do: one does not take service from a sadhu — that is inauspicious. We give service, and the sadhu trains us and gives knowledge.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:09 (auto-transcript): “So Krishna is not acting as a supreme God. He is acting as a normal person, Vrajavasi. He is representing us. We are teaching us what we should do. Because there are many devotees in Christian consciousness. Who are using the spiritual master.”

children.topic: A warning to those who use the guru
children.note:
Many devotees use the spiritual master for their material needs. Krishna is warning everyone with that mentality that it is dangerous. — “Don't take service from sadhus.”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:43 (auto-transcript): “Because there are many devotees in Christian consciousness. Who are using the spiritual master. For their material needs. He is used to use a lot of needs. Krishna is warning all of us who have this mentality. This is dangerous. Don't take service from sadhus. You should give…”

children.topic: Q3 · Fear that life will be finished
children.note:
If prema transforms us so completely, it feels as if our whole life will end. How to overcome the fear the mind raises when one is about to be transformed?

🎙 Maharaj at 33:58 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna Maharaj, thank you very much for this class. Maharaj, just as Prabhuji asked about Krishna Priyama, and you explained how it is really substantial, and once if really we're getting it how much it's changing us it will change so it looks like if you get it really…”

children.topic: Your life ends, real life begins
children.note:
Maharaj answers that being finished does not mean annihilation. Our own life is finished and the real life begins — we remain eternally, full of knowledge. What ends is sinful life.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:33 (auto-transcript): “Guru Dev says that everything is going to be done. Nirovan doesn't mean finished. Nirovan means that everything is done. This means that your own life is finished. And the real life begins. And the real life begins. And the real life begins. We have said many times. We have…”

children.topic: We have never lived a life
children.note:
All along in this material world our senses have been dictating what to do. We start living only on coming to Krishna consciousness, where we are trained to let the soul act instead of the senses. — “We have never lived a life.”

🎙 Maharaj at 35:53 (auto-transcript): “We have said many times. We have never lived a life. We have never lived a life. All alone. All alone. The things we have been in this material world. Our senses have been detecting what we should do. That we have been telling ourselves what we should do. That is what we have…”

children.topic: The eye that sees God shall die
children.note:
Maharaj finds the same teaching in the Bible: seeing God means dying — not the end of the person, but the end of the material life and the start of a full one.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:18 (auto-transcript): “in the Bible the same thing is there the eye that see God shall die if you see God you are dead no I don't want to die so God The eye that seek or shall die means We all of our mature life is finished Now we have a full life to live”

children.topic: Q4 · Servant of Krishna or follower of the gopis?
children.note:
We are told we are Krishna's servants, and also to follow in the gopis' footsteps in madhurya-rasa; a friend even said our relationship is really Radha-dasyam. Which is our sambandha? Maharaj answers that the process is to follow.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:26 (auto-transcript): “so my question is regarding our sambandha with Krishna we have been told to be a servant to Krishna but we are also told to follow in the footsteps of gopis so both are contradictory because one is servitorship and one is the highest follow the footsteps of gopis gopis and we…”

If we follow pure devotees as they are, we become pure devotees — nothing else. A devotee serves, and pure devotees train us how to serve.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:20 (auto-transcript): “Yes, the process is to follow. Follow who? Pure devotees. So if we follow pure devotees, what do we expect to become? What do you think of us?”

The training depends on which pure devotee attracts you. Everyone's individual taste fits into the five rasas, and the gopis in particular represent all of them. One does not think 'I am a gopi' or 'I am a gopa'; I am the servant.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:15 (auto-transcript): “And the training is based on who among the pure devotees is attractive to you. Because all of us, we have individual taste, taste, that taste, fits into the five rashes. All the taste You fit into them”

Maharaj recounts Sanatana Gosvami's Brihad-bhagavatamrita: as Pariksit Maharaj prepared to leave, his mother asked him to tell her all he had heard from Sukadeva Gosvami, and he agreed as a service. His summary was three things — take full shelter of the holy name, desire to serve Krishna like the gopis, and desire to be the servant of the gopis. That is the whole gist of Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:34 (auto-transcript): “Sanatana Goswami told us. Brihat Bhagavatam Rit. After Maharaj Parikshit. He narrated all that he has heard from his Guru. Sugadeva Goswami. When he was about to retire. His mother appeared. And she said. Please. Tell me. All the things you go for my guru. Tell me.”

children.topic: Q5 · Not everyone can serve a sadhu?
children.note:
A mataji asks what to do when only a few get the chance to serve a sadhu. Maharaj replies that everyone has the chance — if you have the desire to serve, you will serve.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:19 (auto-transcript): “Mataji has a question. She's asking that not everybody gets a chance to serve a sadhu. Only few people get to serve a sadhu. So what to be done in that situation? Not everyone has the chance to serve a sadhu. Yeah, not everybody has the chance to serve a sadhu. So what to do?…”

children.topic: Service is not sitting on his lap
children.note:
Serving a sadhu does not mean coming to sit on his lap and gaze at his face. There are so many services: who puts out the mats before class and rolls them up after, who cleans the place, who tends the flowers? — “There's so many services around”

🎙 Maharaj at 48:22 (auto-transcript): “service to a sadhu sadhu ka sewa is not to come and sleep with him his mother said, he will come and sleep to come and sit on his lap he will come and sit in his lap look at his face he will look at his face so I will die like this, remembering a sadhu so I will walk to God's…”

Some devotees cook for the guru, carry the plate to him with great show, and leave the kitchen mess for someone else — then drop the plate behind his back. Do you think the guru does not see this, and that you will get a blessing? — “Do you think that Guru is not seeing this?”

🎙 Maharaj at 50:16 (auto-transcript): “Some devotees. What? They go to the kitchen to cook for Guru. In the kitchen, they make food for the Guru. They make food for the Guru. After they cook for Guru. But after making food. Everything is left there. Then they bring the food. Then they come to the Guru. Eat. Eat.…”

maps.title: Rupa Siksa · Day 15 · Gosvamis Used to Hide to Concentrate

nodeData.topic: Day 15 · Gosvamis Used to Hide to Concentrate
nodeData.note: CC Madhya 19.130–132 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Rupa and Sanatana Gosvami served almost 24 hours a day, barely sleeping, writing, chanting, dancing and remembering Mahaprabhu — for them this was normal life, not austerity. Maharaj tells how Sanatana hid in a bush at Pavan Sarovar to work undisturbed, contrasts the Gosvamis with the sahajiyas who refuse to read or write, and presses Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati's instruction: be Rupa-anuga by writing and distributing books. Questions cover following versus imitating, remembering the acaryas while chanting, why madhurya-rasa is revealed in Kali-yuga, and begging for strength when the mind will not cooperate. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The verse describes how Rupa and Sanatana Gosvami spent their days: almost round-the-clock service, very little sleep, and some days none at all.

Maharaj stresses that for the Gosvamis this schedule is not an austerity and not a rule — it is simply their normal life, so there is nothing surprising in it. — “it is normal life”

🎙 Maharaj at 03:26 (auto-transcript): “this is not austerity it's not a rule it is normal life for them this is normal life”

children.topic: For us, a rule we struggle to keep
children.note:
For us the same engagement is a big austerity, a rule we struggle to keep, maintain and follow. Even when we become pure devotees we remain aware that we gave something up.

🎙 Maharaj at 05:35 (auto-transcript): “for us it's a big austerity it is a rule that we struggle to keep we are struggling to keep struggling to keep not skip keep maintain to follow this is normal life that they are 24 hours engaged not a practice”

The difference: we have given up something to come to the Lord's service, but the Gosvamis had nothing to give up and have sacrificed nothing. — “They have not sacrificed anything.”

🎙 Maharaj at 06:40 (auto-transcript): “we know that we have sacrificed something They have not sacrificed anything. But we have sacrificed something. We have given up something to get spilled off of Godhead. They have not given up anything. They have nothing to give up. So that's the difference. a a a a a”
The verse says the two brothers alternate between writing devotional literature and hearing and thinking about Sri Caitanya Mahaprabhu.

Maharaj says Vyasadeva compiled the scriptures but did not say much about rasa, and asks the room for proof. The proof is Mahaprabhu's own statement: Vyasa discussed knowledge and bhakti in general, madhurya was not discussed, therefore Rupa Gosvami is empowered and given this specific assignment. — “He didn't talk much about Rasa”

🎙 Maharaj at 08:39 (auto-transcript): “He compiled the scriptures What he composed He didn't talk much about Rasa Do you have proof of that? Shri Chandra Maha Prabhu said. Vyasa Dev has compiled Vedas. And he discussed.”

Maharaj lists Rupa Gosvami's works describing Radha and Krishna's pastimes in detail: Bhakti-rasamrta-sindhu, Vidagdha-madhava, Lalita-madhava, Ujjvala-nilamani, Upadesamrta on etiquette, Padyavali as a compilation of many devotees' verses, Dana-keli-kaumudi, Hamsaduta and many more.

🎙 Maharaj at 10:43 (auto-transcript): “So, Rupa Goswami, Satsang Goswami, he wrote so many books. All. all raças describe in details the competition activities of Radha Krishna Radha and Krishna good lilai really focus on me really focus Bhakti Rasamrit Sundhu Vidakta Madhava Lalita Madhava Lalita Madhava With joy…”

Sanatana Gosvami also wrote famous works — Hari-bhakti-vilasa as a guiding principle, Brhad-bhagavatamrta, and commentary — though Rupa Gosvami wrote more.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:11 (auto-transcript): “Srinathana Goswami also wrote many famous ones, that's not the famous one, Adi Bhakti Vilas. That is also a principle. That's a principle. It's a guiding principle. Then, Braha Bhagavatam breath, soul, nectarine. And yes, he has commentary, yes, and many others, many others.…”

children.topic: All of it is rasa, in perfect detail
children.note: Everything the brothers wrote is about rasa, and they put things in perfect detail.

children.topic: 19.132 — Not wonderful for one given mercy
children.note: The verse reports how Mahaprabhu's associates respond on hearing of the brothers' activities: for someone who has received the Lord's mercy, this is not surprising. The purport describes their life under trees and their constant chanting, dancing and remembrance.

children.topic: See them dancing in the mind's eye
children.note:
The Gosvamis did not only sit and write volumes — they also had kirtan and danced. Maharaj asks the room: can you see Rupa and Sanatana dancing? You should imagine it; everything has to begin from somewhere. — “In our mind's eye, we should be able to see Rupa Sanatana.”

🎙 Maharaj at 18:25 (auto-transcript): “where they dance can you imagine are you seeing Goswami having kirtan can you see Do you not see them dancing? Yes, no. You should imagine, everything should begin from somewhere. In our mind's eye, we should be able to see Rupa Sanatana. You should see, they are dancing.…”

Chanting, dancing in kirtan, writing, discussing Krishna, remembering Mahaprabhu — their 24 hours are full. They never miss any of these items, so there is no complaining about missing anything. — “they have no spare time”

🎙 Maharaj at 19:37 (auto-transcript): “Discussing about Krishnaya and remembering, they have 24 hours full of 24 hours, they have no spare time. Don't complain, missing anyone because of something, they didn't miss any one of these items, they are doing it every day, so they don't know what they are writing,”
To hear and discuss, the Gosvamis always came together, as a devotee had noted in the morning class — among themselves they gather to speak about Krishna.

children.topic: Gosvamis used to hide to concentrate
children.note:
The Gosvamis moved from tree to tree, and Maharaj explains why: hiding was how they kept their service free of interruption.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:11 (auto-transcript): “So this is what Goswami do today Under different trees, we were traveling. And sometimes, Sanatana Goswami went to Pavan Sarovar. Bush was in that time, and he was hiding one of the strokes.”

children.topic: Sanatana in a bush at Pavan Sarovar
children.note:
Sanatana Gosvami would go to Pavan Sarovar and hide inside a bush to do his work — no house then, though a temple is being built there now. Krishna himself came and asked: Baba, who will see you here? Who will give you something to eat? — “Who will see you here? Who will see you?”

🎙 Maharaj at 21:27 (auto-transcript): “And sometimes, Sanatana Goswami went to Pavan Sarovar. Bush was in that time, and he was hiding one of the strokes. Sanatana Goswami was hiding there. Now they are constructing in the temple. That time, no house. Sanatana Goswami was hiding there.”

Sanatana is already eating — the nectar of his service — so he has no wish for external eating. When someone comes pressing him to take something, it is painful and disturbing; that is exactly why he hides.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:03 (auto-transcript): “He is not interested in eating. He is already eating. What is the wish for other external eating? He is staying there because he doesn't want to eat. Somebody comes to disturb him. Take something, take something. It is very painful. Painful for the Goswami. If someone comes…”

They planned their Krishna consciousness so that nothing would break it: stay hidden, drink the holy name and Mahaprabhu's pastimes, with no interruption.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:27 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, they plan their Krishna consciousness. Hide and drink. No interruption. And they are Prakritah Sahajyas, who say that for them, the Ushan service means disactivity.”

The purport names the prakrta-sahajiyas, who claim that reading and writing are beneath them. Maharaj asks the room what the word means and takes it apart.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:25 (auto-transcript): “You understand what meaning Prakritah Sahajyas? You understand Prakritah Sahajya? You understand? You understand? What is this earth? Sahajya, Sahajyas, Sahajyas. What is this? earth pretending to take the process to take the highest thing not to make it useless because they…”

children.topic: Pretending to have the highest thing
children.note:
A sahajiya pretends to possess the highest thing cheaply. They know something is there but cannot reach it, so they tell others: you are already there — why write books, for what?

🎙 Maharaj at 25:44 (auto-transcript): “earth pretending to take the process to take the highest thing not to make it useless because they cannot get it they know sahaja know that something is there they cannot get it going to Therefore, you need to write books, write books, you are already there, so why are you…”

children.topic: The books are written for us
children.note:
Those who really are there are very merciful people. They write not for themselves but for us, so that we can get connected.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:54 (auto-transcript): “Those who are there are very, very massive people. So they write it. Not for themselves. For us. To get connected. So the Goswami did not write books to make money. So, Swami has read the book for money to earn money. Srila Prabhupada reads his own books. Have you seen any…”

The Gosvamis did not write to make money. Have you seen any materialist write a book and then read it himself? Yet Srila Prabhupada reads his own books — because Krishna wrote through him, and so it is tasty for him and tasty for us. The sahajiya says no need to read, because he has nothing. — “But Srila Prabhupada reads his own books.”

🎙 Maharaj at 27:15 (auto-transcript): “So the Goswami did not write books to make money. So, Swami has read the book for money to earn money. Srila Prabhupada reads his own books. Have you seen any materialist by writing a book and reading it? They want to make money. But Srila Prabhupada reads his own books. Why…”

children.topic: Write books, distribute widely — be Rupa-anuga
children.note:
After reading Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati's opinion in the purport, Maharaj draws the conclusion: write books and publish them widely — then you are Rupa-anuga.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:49 (auto-transcript): “So write books, publish it widely. If we, then you are Rupa Anuga. Not just a title but activity. But he does that's what he wanted at. He gave authority. Books. And distribute it. Build a temple. Disciple will come and fight.”

children.topic: Not a title but an activity
children.note:
Rupa-anuga is not a label one wears; it is what one does. Prabhupada gave the authority: books, and distribute them. — “Not just a title but activity.”

🎙 Maharaj at 31:05 (auto-transcript): “Not just a title but activity. But he does that's what he wanted at. He gave authority. Books. And distribute it. Build a temple. Disciple will come and fight. If you distribute books, nobody will fight. Why? Because you are busy doing something.”

children.topic: Temples breed fights, books keep us busy
children.note:
Build a temple and disciples come and fight; distribute books from morning till night and nobody has time to fight — you take prasadam, sleep, and start again. In temple life one rings a bell, offers arati, eats twenty or twenty-five chapatis, and the unengaged senses demand engagement: quarrelling, envying, gossiping.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:29 (auto-transcript): “Build a temple. Disciple will come and fight. If you distribute books, nobody will fight. Why? Because you are busy doing something. You are not a member to fight. After distributing books from morning till night. What time will you have for anything else? You have no time…”

Writing and distributing books is the work of Rupa and Sanatana and the other Gosvamis, and Prabhupada said we should be Rupa-anuga by doing it. This is the instruction he received from his own guru.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:39 (auto-transcript): “So Prabhupada said we should be Rupa Nuga by writing books and disabled books. That is the instruction that Prabhupada has given. His Guru has given. But today, we are afraid, don't write books, don't write books, because if you write books, you will tell your disciples to…”

children.topic: Fear of writing books is envy
children.note:
Today people say: do not write books, or you will tell your disciples to read yours and forget Prabhupada's. Maharaj names this envy. If we are followers, we had better do what Prabhupada said.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:03 (auto-transcript): “But today, we are afraid, don't write books, don't write books, because if you write books, you will tell your disciples to read your books and forget Prabhupada's books. If you write a book, you will tell your students that you have read my book, Prabhupada's book, don't…”

Four questions: imitating the Gosvamis, remembering the acaryas while chanting, why madhurya-rasa is revealed in Kali-yuga, and lacking the strength to sacrifice.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:23 (auto-transcript): “For that, can we imitate these Goswamis, especially Rupa Goswami, Sanatana, Raghunata's Goswami, renunciation. So can we imitate this or we have to take a general principles from the teaching that they are giving? Because as you were mentioning that for them it was a natural…”

children.topic: Q1 · Imitate the Gosvamis or draw principles?
children.note:
Can we imitate the renunciation of Rupa, Sanatana and Raghunatha dasa Gosvami, or should we take general principles from their teaching, given that what was natural for them is a big austerity for us?

🎙 Maharaj at 35:23 (auto-transcript): “For that, can we imitate these Goswamis, especially Rupa Goswami, Sanatana, Raghunata's Goswami, renunciation. So can we imitate this or we have to take a general principles from the teaching that they are giving? Because as you were mentioning that for them it was a natural…”

We cannot imitate — we would last one or two days, because we do not have their qualities. Our path is to follow, and following begins from the beginning.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:56 (auto-transcript): “We don't have to imitate it because we cannot do more than two days. Or one day, the next day we are not there. Because we don't have their qualities. So we can't imitate.”

children.topic: Good sadhana first; the rest unfolds
children.note:
